rule("00a1 - Global: Start the game immediately while waiting for players")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Global.GameStartRequested == False;
		Is Game In Progress == False;
		Is Waiting For Players == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Send the game start request only once before the next match."
		Global.GameStartRequested = True;
		Start Game Mode;
	}
}

rule("00a2 - Global: Skip hero selection")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Global.HeroSelectionSkipped == False;
		Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers) == 0;
		Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Null;
		Is Game In Progress == False;
		Is Assembling Heroes == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Initial setup only: end hero selection once."
		Global.HeroSelectionSkipped = True;
		Set Match Time(0);
	}
}

rule("00a3 - Global: Skip initial setup")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Global.SetupSkipped == False;
		Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers) == 0;
		Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Null;
		Is Game In Progress == False;
		Is In Setup == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Initial setup only: end the game setup phase once."
		Global.SetupSkipped = True;
		Set Match Time(0);
	}
}

		Is Game In Progress == True;

		Global.SetupSkipped = True;

rule("00c - Global: Restart exactly once when the countdown ends")

		Global.RestartRequested == False;

		Global.RestartRequested = True;
		Global.HeroSelectionSkipped = False;

rule("01a - Team cycle: Quarantine before preparation")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.LastTeam != Team Of(Event Player);
	}

	actions
	{
		"Brief quarantine: defer full cleanup until the native team transition is stable."
		"Stop the player's icon animation and remove Super Punch before waiting for the team to stabilize; the serial worker clears resource IDs."
		Event Player.PlayerListUpdatePending = False;
		Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed = True;
		Event Player.PlayerCycleActive = True;
		Event Player.IsPrepared = False;
		Event Player.IsHuman = False;
		Global.SuperPunchPlayers = Remove From Array(Global.SuperPunchPlayers, Event Player);
		If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == True);
			Stop Chasing Player Variable(Event Player, ObjectiveIconPosition);
		End;
		Event Player.LastTeam = Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.TeamCycleTargetTeam = Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.TeamCycleDeadline = Total Time Elapsed + 0.500;
		If(Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Event Player);
			Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
			Global.TeamCycleTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		End;
	}
}

rule("01b - Team cycle: Preparation worker from the global scheduler")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Entity Exists(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.IsHuman == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed == True;
		Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Event Player;
		Event Player.TeamCycleTargetTeam == Team Of(Event Player);
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.IsPrepared == False;
		Total Time Elapsed >= Event Player.TeamCycleDeadline;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Separate native state restoration, resource ID cleanup, and preparation; abort if identity, team, or reservation changes."
		Call Subroutine(QuiescePlayer);
		Wait(0.050, Abort When False);
		Abort If(Global.IsReady == False);
		Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True);
		Abort If(Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == True);
		Abort If(Event Player.IsHuman == True);
		Abort If(Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed == False);
		Abort If(Global.TeamCyclePlayer != Event Player);
		Abort If(Event Player.TeamCycleTargetTeam != Team Of(Event Player));
		Abort If(Has Spawned(Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Event Player.IsPrepared == True);
		Abort If(Total Time Elapsed < Event Player.TeamCycleDeadline);
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player));
			Call Subroutine(CleanupPlayer);
		End;
		Wait(0.050, Abort When False);
		Abort If(Global.IsReady == False);
		Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True);
		Abort If(Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == True);
		Abort If(Event Player.IsHuman == True);
		Abort If(Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed == False);
		Abort If(Global.TeamCyclePlayer != Event Player);
		Abort If(Event Player.TeamCycleTargetTeam != Team Of(Event Player));
		Abort If(Has Spawned(Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Event Player.IsPrepared == True);
		Abort If(Total Time Elapsed < Event Player.TeamCycleDeadline);
		Call Subroutine(PreparePlayer);
	}
}

rule("02 - Player: Classify humans and automatic bots")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.IsPrepared == True;
		Event Player.PlayerCycleActive == False;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.LastTeam == Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.PlayerListUpdatePending == False;
		Event Player.IsClassified == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Use the saved name during team changes so registered humans do not get stuck in the automatic bot check."
		"Dead bots still release the queue; rule 03c locks them when they respawn."
		"Do not replace a valid saved name with empty text during a team transition."
		"An empty human name is not a stable identity: leave the player list slot free and reschedule lightweight preparation."
		"Hide native game bars, objectives, and icons while preserving the hero HUD and custom HUDs."
		"Human and bot classification is complete. Create the player HUD once after a stable spawn."
		Event Player.IsClassified = True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot = False;
		Event Player.IsHuman = False;
		Event Player.NameColor = Color(White);
		If(And(Event Player.WasPrepared == True, And(Event Player.DisplayName != Null, Event Player.DisplayName != Custom String(""))));
		Else;
			Start Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Event Player, Custom String("​"));
			Wait(0.016, Ignore Condition);
			Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == False);
			If(Or(Event Player.IsPrepared == False, Has Spawned(Event Player) == False));
				Stop Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Event Player);
				Event Player.IsClassified = False;
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Custom String("{0}", Event Player) == Custom String("​"));
				Event Player.IsAutomaticBot = True;
			End;
			Stop Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Event Player);
		End;
		If(Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == True);
			Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed = False;
			Event Player.PlayerCycleActive = False;
			Event Player.TeamCycleDeadline = 0;
			If(Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Event Player);
				Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
				Global.TeamCycleTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			End;
			Cancel Primary Action(Event Player);
			Call Subroutine(LockBot);
			Abort;
		End;
		Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player));
		If(Count Of(Global.AvailableHudSlots) == 0);
			Event Player.IsClassified = False;
			Event Player.IsPrepared = False;
			Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed = False;
			Event Player.PlayerCycleActive = False;
			Event Player.TeamCycleDeadline = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			If(Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Event Player);
				Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
				Global.TeamCycleTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			End;
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Or(Event Player.WasPrepared == False, Or(Event Player.DisplayName == Null, Event Player.DisplayName == Custom String(""))));
			Event Player.DisplayName = Evaluate Once(Custom String("{0}", Event Player));
		End;
		If(Or(Event Player.DisplayName == Null, Event Player.DisplayName == Custom String("")));
			Event Player.IsClassified = False;
			Event Player.IsPrepared = False;
			Event Player.TeamCycleDeadline = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			If(Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Event Player);
				Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
				Global.TeamCycleTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			End;
			Abort;
		End;
		Disable Game Mode HUD(Event Player);
		Disable Game Mode In-World UI(Event Player);
		Event Player.GenreIndex = -1;
		Event Player.ColorIndex = 0;
		Event Player.NameColor = Global.NameColors[Event Player.ColorIndex];
		If(Event Player.DisplayName == Custom String("งูแรร์"));
			Event Player.CustomSoundtrack = Custom String("Draconian");
			Event Player.ColorIndex = 2;
			Event Player.ColorCursor = 2;
			Event Player.NameColor = Global.NameColors[2];
			Event Player.MenuColor = Global.NameColorRGBValues[2];
			Event Player.IconIndex = 23;
			Event Player.IconCursor = 23;
		End;
		Event Player.HudSlot = First Of(Global.AvailableHudSlots);
		Global.SuperPunchTimes[Event Player.HudSlot] = 0;
		Global.LastHudSlot = Max(Global.LastHudSlot, Event Player.HudSlot);
		Modify Global Variable(AvailableHudSlots, Remove From Array By Index, 0);
		Global.HumanPlayers = Append To Array(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player);
		Disable Nameplates(Event Player, Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, Player Variable(Current Array Element, NameplatesDisabled) == True));
		Global.PlayerListHudIds = Append To Array(Global.PlayerListHudIds, 0);
		Global.MenuHudIds = Append To Array(Global.MenuHudIds, 0);
		Global.InspectionTextIds = Append To Array(Global.InspectionTextIds, 0);
		Global.PlayerHudSlots = Append To Array(Global.PlayerHudSlots, Event Player.HudSlot);
		Event Player.IsHuman = True;
		Event Player.LastHero = Hero Of(Event Player);
		Global.VoteRecountNeeded = True;
		Create HUD Text(Global.HumanPlayers, Null, Custom String("{0} {1} {2}", Global.PlayerIcons[Event Player.IconIndex], Hero Icon String(Is Duplicating(Event Player) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Event Player) : Hero Of(Event Player)), Custom String("{0} - {1}", Evaluate Once(Event Player.DisplayName), Event Player.CustomSoundtrack != Null ? Event Player.CustomSoundtrack : Event Player.GenreIndex >= 0 ? Global.GenreNames[Event Player.GenreIndex] : Custom String("no soundtrack yet"))), And(Global.PerformanceDiagnostics == True, And(Local Player == Host Player, Event Player.HudSlot == Global.LastHudSlot)) ? Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("\n \nLOAD {0}% | AVG {1}% | MAX {2}%", Server Load, Server Load Average, Server Load Peak), Custom String("HUD {0} | IWT {1}", 6 + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.PlayerListHudIds, Current Array Element != 0)) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.MenuHudIds, Current Array Element != 0)) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds, Current Array Element != 0)), Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.InspectionTextIds, Current Array Element != 0)) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds, Current Array Element != 0)) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds, Current Array Element != 0)))) : Custom String(""), Left, 1 + Event Player.HudSlot, Color(White), Event Player.NameColor, Color(White), Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Event Player.PlayerListHud = Last Text ID;
		If(And(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) >= 0, Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.PlayerListHudIds)));
			Global.PlayerListHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)] = Event Player.PlayerListHud;
		End;
		Event Player.PlayerHudCreated = True;
		Event Player.MainMenuCursor = 0;
		Event Player.MenuPage = -1;
		Event Player.MenuOpen = True;
		Call Subroutine(DrawMenu);
		Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Welcome to Cozywatch! Pick a vibe & color. Stay weird."));
	}
}

rule("03c - Bot: Lock on respawn or hero change")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Or(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player), Event Player.IsAutomaticBot) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Or(Event Player.BotLocked == False, Hero Of(Event Player) != Event Player.LastHero) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(LockBot);
		If(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True);
			Event Player.DummyBotTravelTime = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
			Event Player.DummyBotTravelCursor = 0;
			Set Respawn Max Time(Event Player, 3);
		End;
	}
}

rule("03d - Subroutine: Maintain dummy bot slots for both teams at 1 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		MaintainDummyBots;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Prioritize human slots; apply a retry delay per team before creating a bot, including after native creation failures."
		Abort If(Global.IsReady == False);
		Abort If(Is Game In Progress == False);
		Abort If(Global.TeamCyclePlayer != Null);
		If(Number Of Players(Team 1) >= Number Of Slots(Team 1));
			If(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 1), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) > 0);
				Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam = Team 1;
				Global.Team1DummyBotRetryTime = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
				Call Subroutine(RemoveTeamDummyBot);
			End;
		Else;
			If(And(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Skirmish), And(Number Of Players(Team 1) < Number Of Slots(Team 1) - 1, And(Count Of(Spawn Points(Team 1)) > 0, And(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 1), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) == 0, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.Team1DummyBotRetryTime)))));
				Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam = Team 1;
				Global.Team1DummyBotRetryTime = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
				Call Subroutine(CreateTeamDummyBot);
			End;
		End;
		If(Number Of Players(Team 2) >= Number Of Slots(Team 2));
			If(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 2), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) > 0);
				Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam = Team 2;
				Global.Team2DummyBotRetryTime = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
				Call Subroutine(RemoveTeamDummyBot);
			End;
		Else;
			If(And(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Skirmish), And(Number Of Players(Team 2) < Number Of Slots(Team 2) - 1, And(Count Of(Spawn Points(Team 2)) > 0, And(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 2), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) == 0, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.Team2DummyBotRetryTime)))));
				Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam = Team 2;
				Global.Team2DummyBotRetryTime = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
				Call Subroutine(CreateTeamDummyBot);
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("03f - Bot: Travel from spawn to the objective")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True;
		Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Skirmish);
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Is In Spawn Room(Event Player) == True;
		Count Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Event Player))) > 0;
		Or(Event Player.DummyBotTravelTime == 0, Total Time Elapsed >= Event Player.DummyBotTravelTime) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Try a different horizontal direction each second, then repeat at a greater distance."
		If(Event Player.DummyBotTravelTime == 0);
			Event Player.DummyBotTravelTime = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
			Event Player.DummyBotTravelCursor = 0;
			Abort;
		End;
		Event Player.DummyBotTravelTime = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
		Event Player.DeathPosition = Objective Position(Objective Index);
		Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.DeathPosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.DeathPosition + Direction From Angles(Horizontal Angle From Direction(Direction Towards(Event Player.DeathPosition, Position Of(First Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Event Player)))))) + Event Player.DummyBotTravelCursor % 8 * 45, 0) * (Event Player.DummyBotTravelCursor < 8 ? 8 : 12));
			Event Player.TravelDestination = Event Player.SafeRevivePosition;
			Event Player.DummyBotTravelCursor = (Event Player.DummyBotTravelCursor + 1) % 16;
			Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
			If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Event Player.DeathPosition) >= 6);
				If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Event Player.DeathPosition) <= 16);
					If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 5, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition - Vector(0, 20, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition) <= 6);
						If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
							Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.SafeRevivePosition);
						End;
					End;
				End;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("03g - Bot: Face and approach the nearest living enemy human")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.DummyBotFollowTarget != Null;
		Entity Exists(Event Player.DummyBotFollowTarget) == True;
		Player Variable(Event Player.DummyBotFollowTarget, IsHuman) == True;
		Player Variable(Event Player.DummyBotFollowTarget, AllowDummyBotFollow) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player.DummyBotFollowTarget) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player.DummyBotFollowTarget) == True;
		Team Of(Event Player.DummyBotFollowTarget) == Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Event Player));
	}

	actions
	{
		Start Facing(Event Player, Direction Towards(Eye Position(Event Player), Eye Position(Event Player.DummyBotFollowTarget)), 1000, To World, Direction and Turn Rate);
		Start Throttle In Direction(Event Player, Forward, Or(Is In Spawn Room(Event Player), Distance Between(Event Player, Event Player.DummyBotFollowTarget) <= 4) ? 0 : 1, To Player, Replace Existing Throttle, Direction and Magnitude);
	}
}

rule("03h - Bot: Stop moving when no enemy human is alive")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True;

	}

	actions
	{
		Stop Facing(Event Player);
		Stop Throttle In Direction(Event Player);
	}
}

rule("04 - Player left: Clean up only after an actual departure")
{
	event
	{
		Player Left Match;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Or(Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == True, Or(Event Player.IsHuman == True, Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == True);
			If(Event Player.LuckVisionText != Null);
				If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player) >= 0);
					If(Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] == Event Player.LuckVisionText);
						Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.LuckVisionText);
						Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = 0;
					End;
				End;
			End;
			Event Player.LuckVisionText = Null;
			Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Event Player;
			Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
			Abort;
		End;
		Wait(0.500, Ignore Condition);
		Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == True);
		Call Subroutine(CleanupPlayer);
		If(Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Event Player);
			Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
			Global.TeamCycleTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		End;
	}
}

rule("04g - Global main loop: Central scheduler at 20 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"The 0.05 second step is the script's only update source and only repeating loop."
		"Once per second, hold native game completion and keep its timer above zero until the server timer expires."
		"A player list snapshot prevents the active collection from changing during a scheduler pass."
		"Unclassified entities still enter preparation; classified bots only enter bot maintenance."
		"Process icon deadlines even after effects end or while a player changes teams."
		"Camera and inspection recovery continue during team transition quarantine."
		"Choose a hero automatically once, then immediately release forcing so the player can freely change heroes."
		Global.SchedulerStep = (Global.SchedulerStep + 1) % 200;
		If(Global.SchedulerStep % 2 == 0);
			Global.RGB = Custom Color(80 + (Global.RGBPhase < 255 ? 255 : Global.RGBPhase < 510 ? 510 - Global.RGBPhase : Global.RGBPhase < 1020 ? 0 : Global.RGBPhase < 1275 ? Global.RGBPhase - 1020 : 255) * 0.686, 80 + (Global.RGBPhase < 255 ? Global.RGBPhase : Global.RGBPhase < 765 ? 255 : Global.RGBPhase < 1020 ? 1020 - Global.RGBPhase : 0) * 0.686, 80 + (Global.RGBPhase < 510 ? 0 : Global.RGBPhase < 765 ? Global.RGBPhase - 510 : Global.RGBPhase < 1275 ? 255 : 1530 - Global.RGBPhase) * 0.686, 255);
			Global.RGBPhase = (Global.RGBPhase + 3) % 1530;
		End;
		If(And(Global.SchedulerStep % 20 == 0, Global.RestartRequested == False));
			Global.ServerTimeRemaining = Max(0, Round To Integer(Global.ServerEndTime - Total Time Elapsed, Up));
			Global.ServerTimeText = Global.ServerTimeRemaining % 60 < 10 ? Custom String("{0}:0{1}", Round To Integer(Global.ServerTimeRemaining / 60, Down), Global.ServerTimeRemaining % 60) : Custom String("{0}:{1}", Round To Integer(Global.ServerTimeRemaining / 60, Down), Global.ServerTimeRemaining % 60);
			If(And(Is Game In Progress == True, Global.ServerTimeRemaining > 0));
				Disable Built-In Game Mode Completion;
				Set Match Time(Max(1, Global.ServerTimeRemaining));
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.TeamCyclePlayer != Null, Or(Entity Exists(Global.TeamCyclePlayer) == False, Has Spawned(Global.TeamCyclePlayer) == False)));
			Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
			Global.TeamCycleTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		End;
		Global.PlayerListSnapshot = All Players(All Teams);
		If(Is True For Any(Global.PlayerListSnapshot, Player Variable(Current Array Element, LuckPrivacyActive) == True));
			Global.LuckVisionViewers = Filtered Array(Global.PlayerListSnapshot, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman) == True, Player Variable(Current Array Element, LuckPrivacyActive) == True)));
		Else;
			If(Count Of(Global.LuckVisionViewers) > 0);
				Global.LuckVisionViewers = Empty Array;
			End;
		End;
		For Global Variable(SchedulerPlayerIndex, 0, Count Of(Global.PlayerListSnapshot), 1);
			Global.ActivePlayer = Global.PlayerListSnapshot[Global.SchedulerPlayerIndex];
			If(And(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer) == False, Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot == False));
				Call Subroutine(ProcessPlayerFastState);
				If(Array Contains(Global.SuperPunchPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer));
					Call Subroutine(ProcessSuperPunch);
				End;
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpEnabled == True);
					Call Subroutine(ProcessMultijump);
				End;
				If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive == True, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount > 0, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect != 0, Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime > 0))));
					Call Subroutine(ProcessPlayerLuck);
				End;
				If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, Global.ActivePlayer.FlyModeActive == True));
					Call Subroutine(ProcessPlayerFlight);
				End;
				If(Global.SchedulerStep % 2 == (Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True ? Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot : Slot Of(Global.ActivePlayer)) % 2);
					Call Subroutine(ProcessPlayerCycle);
				End;
				If(Global.SchedulerStep % 20 == (Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True ? Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot : Slot Of(Global.ActivePlayer)) % 20);
					If(Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionComplete == False);
						If(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True);
							Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionComplete = True;
							Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline = 0;
						Else;
							If(Or(Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer) == Team 1, Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer) == Team 2));
								If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline > 0, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline));
									Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionComplete = True;
									Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline = 0;
									Start Forcing Player To Be Hero(Global.ActivePlayer, Hero(Shion));
									Stop Forcing Player To Be Hero(Global.ActivePlayer);
								End;
							Else;
								Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline = 0;
							End;
						End;
					End;
					If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.AllowDummyBotFollow == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen == True, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuPage == 2, Global.ActivePlayer.MenuPage == 4)))));
						Call Subroutine(ProcessPlayerMaintenance);
					End;
				End;
			Else;
				If(Global.SchedulerStep % 2 == Slot Of(Global.ActivePlayer) % 2);
					Call Subroutine(ProcessPlayerBot);
				End;
			End;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer = Null;
		Global.PlayerListSnapshot = Empty Array;
		If(Global.SchedulerStep % 20 == 0);
			Call Subroutine(MaintainDummyBots);
			Call Subroutine(UpdateSocialObjectiveIcons);
			Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
			Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
		End;
		If(Global.VoteRecountNeeded == True);
			Global.VoteRecountNeeded = False;
			Call Subroutine(RecountVotes);
		End;
		Wait(0.050, Ignore Condition);
		Loop If Condition Is True;
	}
}

rule("05 - Menu: Hold Melee for 0.5 seconds to open or close")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.MeleeConsumed == False;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelActive == False;
		Event Player.LuckActive == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Melee)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Wait(0.500, Abort When False);
		Event Player.MeleeConsumed = True;
		If(Event Player.MenuOpen == True);
			Call Subroutine(CloseMenu);
		Else;
			Event Player.MenuOpen = True;
			Event Player.MenuPage = -1;
			Call Subroutine(DrawMenu);
		End;
	}
}

rule("05b - Menu: Release Melee before using it again")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MeleeConsumed == True;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Melee)) == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.MenuOpen == False);
			Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Melee));
		End;
		Event Player.MeleeConsumed = False;
	}
}

rule("05c - Menu: Input controller with fixed priority")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.MenuOpen == True;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == True;
		Event Player.MenuCommand == 0;
		Event Player.CameraInteractConsumed == False;
		Event Player.LuckActive == False;
		Or(Or(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)), And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Reload)), Event Player.MenuPage != -1)), Or(Or(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire)), Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire))), And(Event Player.MenuPage == 3, Or(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 1)), Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 2)))))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)));
			Event Player.CameraInteractConsumed = True;
			Event Player.MenuCommand = 1;
		Else If(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Reload)), Event Player.MenuPage != -1));
			Event Player.MenuCommand = 2;
		Else If(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire)));
			Event Player.MenuCommand = 3;
		Else If(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire)));
			Event Player.MenuCommand = 4;
		Else If(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 1)), Event Player.MenuPage == 3));
			Event Player.MenuCommand = 5;
		Else If(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 2)), Event Player.MenuPage == 3));
			Event Player.MenuCommand = 6;
		End;
	}
}

rule("05d - Menu: Release the controller after all inputs are released")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.MenuCommand != 0;
		And(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)) == False, Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Reload)) == False), And(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire)) == False, Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire)) == False), And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 1)) == False, Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 2)) == False))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Rearm the controller as soon as all buttons are released; latches still prevent repeats while buttons remain held."
		Event Player.MenuCommand = 0;
	}
}

rule("05e - Menu: Crouch locks hero inputs only during navigation")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.MenuOpen == True;
		Event Player.MenuInputLocked == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.MenuInputLocked = True;
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Reload));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 1));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 2));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("05f - Menu: Release Crouch and immediately restore hero inputs")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed == False;
		Event Player.PlayerCycleActive == False;
		Event Player.MenuInputLocked == True;
		Or(Event Player.MenuOpen == False, Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == False) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ultimate));
		Event Player.MenuInputLocked = False;
		Event Player.MenuCommand = 0;
	}
}

rule("06 - Menu: Navigate forward and backward")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MenuOpen == True;
		Or(Event Player.MenuCommand == 3, Event Player.MenuCommand == 4) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.MenuPage == -1);
			Event Player.MainMenuCursor = (Event Player.MainMenuCursor + (Event Player.MenuCommand == 3 ? 1 : 15)) % 16;
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 1);
			Event Player.ColorCursor = (Event Player.ColorCursor + (Event Player.MenuCommand == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Global.NameColors) - 1)) % Count Of(Global.NameColors);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 2);
			Call Subroutine(RefreshCameraTargets);
			Event Player.CameraCursor = (Event Player.CameraCursor + (Event Player.MenuCommand == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Event Player.CameraTargets) + 1)) % (Count Of(Event Player.CameraTargets) + 2);
		Else If(And(Event Player.MenuPage == 3, Event Player.CustomSoundtrack == Null));
			Event Player.GenreCursor = (Event Player.GenreCursor + (Event Player.MenuCommand == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Global.GenreNames) - 1)) % Count Of(Global.GenreNames);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 4);
			Call Subroutine(RefreshRevengeTargets);
			If(Count Of(Event Player.RevengeTargets) > 0);
				Event Player.RevengeCursor = (Event Player.RevengeCursor + (Event Player.MenuCommand == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Event Player.RevengeTargets) - 1)) % Count Of(Event Player.RevengeTargets);
			End;
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 5);
			Event Player.UnkillableCursor = (Event Player.UnkillableCursor + (Event Player.MenuCommand == 3 ? 1 : 2)) % 3;
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 6);
			Event Player.VoiceCursor = (Event Player.VoiceCursor + (Event Player.MenuCommand == 3 ? 1 : 4)) % 5;
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 7);
			Event Player.IconCursor = (Event Player.IconCursor + (Event Player.MenuCommand == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Global.PlayerIcons) - 1)) % Count Of(Global.PlayerIcons);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 11);
			If(Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers) > 0);
				Event Player.VoteCursor = (Event Player.VoteCursor + (Event Player.MenuCommand == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers) - 1)) % Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers);
			End;
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 13);
			Event Player.GhostFlyCursor = (Event Player.GhostFlyCursor + 1) % 2;
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 14);
			Event Player.MultijumpCursor = (Event Player.MultijumpCursor + (Event Player.MenuCommand == 3 ? 1 : 10)) % 11;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(TransitionMenuColor);
	}
}

rule("08 - Soundtrack menu: Jump forward or backward by ten genres")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MenuOpen == True;
		Event Player.MenuPage == 3;
		Event Player.CustomSoundtrack == Null;
		Or(Event Player.MenuCommand == 5, Event Player.MenuCommand == 6) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.GenreCursor = (Event Player.GenreCursor + (Event Player.MenuCommand == 5 ? 10 : Count Of(Global.GenreNames) - 10)) % Count Of(Global.GenreNames);
	}
}

rule("10 - Menu: Apply the active page")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MenuOpen == True;
		Event Player.MenuCommand == 1;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Apply the four main toggles directly while keeping the page and cursor in the main menu."
		If(Event Player.MenuPage == -1);
			If(Event Player.MainMenuCursor == 8);
				Call Subroutine(ApplyCrouchTravel);
			Else If(Event Player.MainMenuCursor == 9);
				Call Subroutine(ApplyInspectionPrivacyPage);
			Else If(Event Player.MainMenuCursor == 12);
				Call Subroutine(ApplyDummyBotFollowPage);
			Else If(Event Player.MainMenuCursor == 15);
				Call Subroutine(ApplySuperPunchPage);
			Else;
				Event Player.MenuPage = Event Player.MainMenuCursor;
				If(Event Player.MenuPage == 2);
					Call Subroutine(RefreshCameraTargets);
				Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 4);
					Call Subroutine(RefreshRevengeTargets);
				Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 5);
					Event Player.UnkillableCursor = Event Player.UnkillableMode;
				Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 11);
					Event Player.VoteCursor = And(Event Player.VotedPlayer != Null, Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player.VotedPlayer)) ? Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player.VotedPlayer) : Min(Event Player.VoteCursor, Max(0, Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers) - 1));
				Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 13);
					Event Player.GhostFlyCursor %= 2;
				Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 14);
					Event Player.MultijumpCursor = Event Player.MultijumpEnabled ? Event Player.MultijumpLevel : 0;
				End;
				Call Subroutine(DrawMenu);
			End;
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 1);
			Call Subroutine(ApplyNameColorPage);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 2);
			Call Subroutine(ApplyCameraPage);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 3);
			Call Subroutine(ApplySoundtrackPage);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 4);
			Call Subroutine(ApplyRevengePage);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 5);
			Call Subroutine(ApplyUnkillablePage);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 6);
			Call Subroutine(ApplyHeroVoicePage);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 7);
			Call Subroutine(ApplyPlayerIconPage);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 10);
			Call Subroutine(ApplyLuckPage);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 11);
			Call Subroutine(ApplyVotePage);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 13);
			Call Subroutine(ApplyGhostFlyPage);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 14);
			Call Subroutine(ApplyMultijumpPage);
		End;
	}
}

rule("99a - Subroutine: Apply the Soundtrack page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplySoundtrackPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Event Player.CustomSoundtrack != Null);
		If(Event Player.GenreIndex != Event Player.GenreCursor);
			Event Player.GenreIndex = Event Player.GenreCursor;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99b - Subroutine: Apply the Camera page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyCameraPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(RefreshCameraTargets);
		Event Player.CameraCursor %= Count Of(Event Player.CameraTargets) + 2;
		If(Event Player.CameraCursor == 0);
			If(Event Player.CameraMode != 0);
				Stop Camera(Event Player);
				Event Player.CameraMode = 0;
				Event Player.CameraTarget = Null;
			End;
		Else If(Event Player.CameraCursor == 1);
			If(Or(Event Player.CameraMode != 1, Event Player.CameraTarget != Event Player));
				Event Player.CameraTarget = Event Player;
				Event Player.CameraMode = 1;
				Global.CameraPlayer = Event Player;
				Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
				Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
			End;
		Else;
			If(Event Player.CameraCursor - 2 < Count Of(Event Player.CameraTargets));
				Event Player.CameraTargetCandidate = Event Player.CameraTargets[Event Player.CameraCursor - 2];
			Else;
				Event Player.CameraTargetCandidate = Null;
			End;
			If(And(Event Player.CameraTargetCandidate != Null, Entity Exists(Event Player.CameraTargetCandidate)));
				If(Or(Event Player.CameraMode != 2, Event Player.CameraTarget != Event Player.CameraTargetCandidate));
					Event Player.CameraTarget = Event Player.CameraTargetCandidate;
					Event Player.CameraMode = 2;
					Global.CameraPlayer = Event Player;
					Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
					Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
				End;
			Else;
				Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Camera target unavailable. Poof!"));
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99c - Subroutine: Apply the Name Color page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyNameColorPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.ColorIndex != Event Player.ColorCursor);
			Event Player.ColorIndex = Event Player.ColorCursor;
			Event Player.NameColor = Global.NameColors[Event Player.ColorIndex];
			If(Global.VoteLeader == Event Player);
				Global.VoteLeaderColor = Event Player.NameColor;
			End;
		End;
	}
}


rule("99e - Subroutine: Apply the Revenge page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyRevengePage;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And(Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget != Null, And(Entity Exists(Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget), Player Variable(Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget, RevengeClaimant) == Event Player)));
			Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Revenge pending. Debt drops when the target dies."));
		Else;
			Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
			Call Subroutine(RefreshRevengeTargets);
			If(Count Of(Event Player.RevengeTargets) == 0);
				Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("No revenge targets. Peace wins!"));
			Else;
				Event Player.RevengeCursor %= Count Of(Event Player.RevengeTargets);
				Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget = Event Player.RevengeTargets[Event Player.RevengeCursor];
				Event Player.RevengeIndex = Index Of Array Value(Event Player.RevengeKillers, Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget);
				If(Event Player.RevengeIndex < 0);
					Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("No revenge debt on that player."));
					Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
				Else If(Event Player.RevengeDebts[Event Player.RevengeIndex] <= 0);
					Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Revenge debt cleared. Case closed!"));
					Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
				Else If(Or(Entity Exists(Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget) == False, Is Alive(Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget) == False));
					Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Revenge target already down."));
					Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
				Else If(Player Variable(Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget, RevengeDeathPending) == True);
					Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Revenge pending on that target."));
					Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
				Else If(Player Variable(Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget, LuckActive) == True);
					Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Target busy with Try Your Luck."));
					Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
				Else;
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget, RevengeDeathPending, True);
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget, RevengeClaimant, Event Player);
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget, NextForcedRevengeTime, Total Time Elapsed);
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget, ForcedRevengeEndTime, Total Time Elapsed + 5);
					Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Revenge on {0}. Confirming the kill.", Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget));
				End;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99f - Subroutine: Apply the Unkillable page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyUnkillablePage;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.UnkillableMode != Event Player.UnkillableCursor);
			If(And(Event Player.UnkillableCursor == 1, Is In Spawn Room(Event Player) == True));
				Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("1 HP is disabled in spawn. FULL HP works."));
			Else;
				Event Player.UnkillableMode = Event Player.UnkillableCursor;
				Event Player.UnkillableActive = Event Player.UnkillableMode != 0;
				If(Event Player.UnkillableMode == 0);
					Clear Status(Event Player, Unkillable);
					Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
					Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
					Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
					If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
						Set Player Health(Event Player, Max Health(Event Player));
					End;
					If(Event Player.UnkillableIcon != Null);
						Destroy Icon(Event Player.UnkillableIcon);
						Event Player.UnkillableIcon = Null;
						If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player));
							Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)]] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				Else;
					Clear Status(Event Player, Unkillable);
					Set Status(Event Player, Null, Unkillable, 9999);
					If(Event Player.UnkillableMode == 1);
						Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
						Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
						Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
						If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
							Set Player Health(Event Player, 1);
						End;
					Else;
						Set Damage Received(Event Player, 0);
						Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 0);
						Disable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
						If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
							Set Player Health(Event Player, Max Health(Event Player));
						End;
					End;
					If(Event Player.UnkillableIcon != Null);
						Destroy Icon(Event Player.UnkillableIcon);
						Event Player.UnkillableIcon = Null;
						If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player));
							Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)]] = 0;
						End;
					End;
					If(Event Player.UnkillableMode == 1);
						Create Icon(All Players(All Teams), Event Player, Warning, Visible To and Position, Custom Color(255, 80, 80, 255), True);
					Else;
						Create Icon(All Players(All Teams), Event Player, Halo, Visible To and Position, Global.RGB, True);
					End;
					Event Player.UnkillableIcon = Last Created Entity;
					If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player));
						Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)]] = Event Player.UnkillableIcon;
					End;
				End;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99g - Subroutine: Apply the Hero Voice page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyHeroVoicePage;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.VoiceIndex != Event Player.VoiceCursor);
			Event Player.VoiceIndex = Event Player.VoiceCursor;
			If(Event Player.VoiceIndex == 0);
				Stop Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player);
			Else If(Event Player.VoiceIndex == 1);
				Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player, 0.500, False);
			Else If(Event Player.VoiceIndex == 2);
				Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player, 0.750, False);
			Else If(Event Player.VoiceIndex == 3);
				Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player, 1.250, False);
			Else;
				Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player, 1.500, False);
			End;
		End;
	}
}

	event
	{

	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.IconIndex != Event Player.IconCursor);
			Event Player.IconIndex = Event Player.IconCursor;
		End;
	}
}

	}

rule("99j - Subroutine: Apply the Inspection Privacy page")
{

	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyInspectionPrivacyPage;

	{
		Event Player.InspectionPrivacyActive = Event Player.InspectionPrivacyActive == False;
	}
}

rule("99k - Subroutine: Apply the Try Your Luck page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyLuckPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Try Your Luck preserves the Unkillable preference; only the Skull's full death suspends protection until revival."
		If(Event Player.LuckActive == True);
			Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Try Your Luck already active."));
		Else If(Event Player.RevengeDeathPending == True);
			Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Under Revenge. Try Your Luck is locked."));
		Else;
			Event Player.LuckActive = True;
			Event Player.LuckEffect = Random Integer(1, 6);
			Event Player.LuckSpinCount = Random Integer(20, 24);
			Event Player.LuckSpinInterval = 0.080;
			Event Player.LuckEffectEndTime = 0;
			Event Player.NextLuckBurnTime = 0;
			Event Player.NextLuckSpinTime = Total Time Elapsed;
			Event Player.LuckIconEndTime = 0;
			Event Player.LuckPrivacyActive = False;
			Event Player.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = False;
			If(Event Player.LuckIcon != Null);
				Destroy Icon(Event Player.LuckIcon);
			End;
			Event Player.LuckIcon = Null;
			If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player));
				Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)]] = 0;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99l - Subroutine: Apply the Vote page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyVotePage;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Store the owner's vote; the scheduler recounts all changes together on the next step."
		If(Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers) > 0);
			Event Player.VoteCursor %= Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers);
			If(Event Player.VotedPlayer != Global.HumanPlayers[Event Player.VoteCursor]);
				Event Player.VotedPlayer = Global.HumanPlayers[Event Player.VoteCursor];
				Global.VoteRecountNeeded = True;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99m - Subroutine: Apply dummy bot follow permission")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyDummyBotFollowPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Enable permission only when an enemy dummy bot exists; disabling it is always allowed."
		Abort If(And(Event Player.AllowDummyBotFollow == False, Is True For Any(All Players(Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Event Player))), And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) == False));
		Event Player.AllowDummyBotFollow = Event Player.AllowDummyBotFollow == False;
	}
}

rule("99n - Subroutine: Apply the Ghost / Fly page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyGhostFlyPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.GhostFlyCursor == 0);
			Event Player.GhostModeActive = Event Player.GhostModeActive == False;
		Else;
			Event Player.FlyModeActive = Event Player.FlyModeActive == False;
		End;
		Event Player.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = False;
		Call Subroutine(ApplyGhostFlyPhysics);
	}
}

rule("99o - Subroutine: Apply Ghost / Fly physics")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyGhostFlyPhysics;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.GhostModeActive == True);
			Disable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player, False);
		Else;
			Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player);
		End;
		Event Player.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Event Player);
		If(Event Player.FlyModeActive == True);
			If(Or(Event Player.LuckEffect != 2, Event Player.LuckEffectEndTime <= Total Time Elapsed));
				Set Move Speed(Event Player, 0);
			End;
			Set Gravity(Event Player, 0);
		Else;
			If(Or(Event Player.LuckEffect != 2, Event Player.LuckEffectEndTime <= Total Time Elapsed));
				Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
				If(Magnitude Of(Velocity Of(Event Player)) > 0.010);
					Apply Impulse(Event Player, Velocity Of(Event Player) * -1, Magnitude Of(Velocity Of(Event Player)), To World, Incorporate Contrary Motion);
				End;
			End;
			Set Gravity(Event Player, 100);
		End;
		Event Player.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = True;
	}
}

rule("12c - Camera: Hold Interact for half a second to switch")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.CameraInteractConsumed == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Wait(0.500, Abort When False);
		Event Player.CameraInteractConsumed = True;
		If(Event Player.CameraMode == 0);
			Event Player.CameraTarget = Event Player;
			Event Player.CameraMode = 1;
			Global.CameraPlayer = Event Player;
			Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
			Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
		Else;
			Stop Camera(Event Player);
			Event Player.CameraMode = 0;
			Event Player.CameraTarget = Null;
		End;
	}
}

rule("12e - Jump revive: Store the death position")
{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;
		All;
	}

	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Keep the Jump latch through another death; only releasing the button permits another attempt."
		Event Player.DeathPosition = Position Of(Event Player);
		Stop Accelerating(Event Player);
		Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Event Player);
		Set Gravity(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player);
		Event Player.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = False;
		Event Player.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
		Event Player.MenuCommand = 0;
		Event Player.TravelCommand = 0;
		Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Press {0}: revive here. Void death? Back to walkable ground.", Input Binding String(Button(Jump))));
	}
}

rule("12f - Jump revive: Revive at a safe walkable position")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.JumpReviveConsumed == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Jump)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Find walkable ground once; a raycast can hit a cliff surface that is still unsafe."
		"Teleport before revival, then confirm the same destination afterward without waiting a frame."
		Event Player.JumpReviveConsumed = True;
		Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position(Position Of(Event Player));
		Event Player.ReviveTeleportNeeded = Or(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.DeathPosition + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.DeathPosition - Vector(0, 3, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.DeathPosition) > 2.500, Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Event Player.DeathPosition) > 0.500);
		If(Event Player.ReviveTeleportNeeded == True);
			Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0.500, 0));
		End;
		Resurrect(Event Player);
		If(Event Player.ReviveTeleportNeeded == True);
			Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0.500, 0));
		End;
		Event Player.ReviveTeleportNeeded = False;
		If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
			Event Player.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = False;
			Call Subroutine(ApplyGhostFlyPhysics);
		End;
	}
}

rule("13 - Hero inspection: Name follows the aim target")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.MenuOpen == False;
		Event Player.LuckPrivacyActive == False;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelActive == False;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelEnabled == False;
		Event Player.CameraMode != 2;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == True;
		Or(Event Player.InspectionTarget != Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate, Or(And(Event Player.InspectionText != Null, Or(Entity Exists(Event Player.InspectionTarget) == False, Or(Has Spawned(Event Player.InspectionTarget) == False, Or(Is Alive(Event Player.InspectionTarget) == False, And(And(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player.InspectionTarget) == False, Player Variable(Event Player.InspectionTarget, IsAutomaticBot) == False), Or(Player Variable(Event Player.InspectionTarget, IsHuman) == False, Or(Player Variable(Event Player.InspectionTarget, InspectionPrivacyActive) == True, Player Variable(Event Player.InspectionTarget, PlayerListUpdatePending) == True))))))), And(Event Player.InspectionText == Null, And(Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate != Null, Total Time Elapsed >= Event Player.NextTargetTextTime)))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Limit combined name creation to four times per second; remove the old name before checking the deadline."
		If(Event Player.InspectionActive == False);
			Event Player.InspectionActive = True;
			Disable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Event Player);
			Event Player.NameplatesDisabled = True;
		End;
		If(Event Player.InspectionText != Null);
			Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.InspectionText);
		End;
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds));
				Global.InspectionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)] = 0;
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.InspectionText = Null;
		Call Subroutine(RefreshInspectionTarget);
		Abort If(Event Player.InspectionTarget == Null);
		Abort If(Total Time Elapsed < Event Player.NextTargetTextTime);
		Event Player.NextTargetTextTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		Create In-World Text(Event Player, Custom String("{0} {1} | {2}", Hero Icon String(Is Duplicating(Evaluate Once(Event Player.InspectionTarget)) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Evaluate Once(Event Player.InspectionTarget)) : Hero Of(Evaluate Once(Event Player.InspectionTarget))), Evaluate Once(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player.InspectionTarget) == True ? Player Variable(Event Player.InspectionTarget, DisplayName) : Custom String("{0}", Is Duplicating(Event Player.InspectionTarget) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Event Player.InspectionTarget) : Hero Of(Event Player.InspectionTarget))), Round To Integer(Health(Evaluate Once(Event Player.InspectionTarget)), Down)), Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Event Player.InspectionTarget)) + Vector(0, 0.450, 0)), 1.100, Do Not Clip, Visible To Position String and Color, Evaluate Once(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player.InspectionTarget) == True ? Player Variable(Event Player.InspectionTarget, NameColor) : Color(Orange)), Visible Never);
		Event Player.InspectionText = Last Text ID;
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds));
				Global.InspectionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)] = Event Player.InspectionText;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("17 - Revenge: Record only the direct killer")
{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.RevengeDeathPending == True);
			If(Is Alive(Event Player) == False);
				If(And(Event Player.RevengeClaimant != Null, And(Entity Exists(Event Player.RevengeClaimant), And(Player Variable(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, IsHuman) == True, Attacker == Event Player.RevengeClaimant))));
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, RevengeIndex, Index Of Array Value(Player Variable(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, RevengeKillers), Event Player));
					If(And(Player Variable(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, RevengeIndex) >= 0, Player Variable(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, RevengeDebts)[Player Variable(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, RevengeIndex)] > 0));
						Modify Player Variable At Index(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, RevengeDebts, Player Variable(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, RevengeIndex), Subtract, 1);
						Small Message(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, Custom String("Revenge on {0}: paid! Still owed: {1}.", Event Player, Player Variable(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, RevengeDebts)[Player Variable(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, RevengeIndex)]));
					End;
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, LockedRevengeTarget, Null);
					Event Player.RevengeDeathPending = False;
					Event Player.RevengeClaimant = Null;
					Event Player.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
					Event Player.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
					Abort;
				End;
				If(And(Event Player.RevengeClaimant != Null, Entity Exists(Event Player.RevengeClaimant)));
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, LockedRevengeTarget, Null);
				End;
				Event Player.RevengeDeathPending = False;
				Event Player.RevengeClaimant = Null;
				Event Player.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
				Event Player.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
			Else;
				Abort;
			End;
		End;
		Abort If(Attacker == Null);
		Abort If(Attacker == Event Player);
		Abort If(Player Variable(Attacker, IsHuman) == False);
		Event Player.RevengeIndex = Index Of Array Value(Event Player.RevengeKillers, Attacker);
		If(Event Player.RevengeIndex < 0);
			Event Player.RevengeKillers = Append To Array(Event Player.RevengeKillers, Attacker);
			Event Player.RevengeDebts = Append To Array(Event Player.RevengeDebts, 1);
		Else;
			Modify Player Variable At Index(Event Player, RevengeDebts, Event Player.RevengeIndex, Add, 1);
		End;
	}
}

rule("18i - Luck: Vision displays all player and bot names")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Or(Array Contains(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player), Array Contains(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null)) == True;
		Or(Event Player.LuckVisionText == Null, Event Player.LuckVisionText == 0) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Or(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True, Or(Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == True, Event Player.IsHuman == True)) == True;
		Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.LuckVisionViewers, And(Current Array Element != Event Player, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman) == True, Player Variable(Current Array Element, LuckPrivacyActive) == True))))) > 0;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Register the owner before creating text; do not overwrite another player's resources."
		Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player);
		If(Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0);
			Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);
			If(Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0);
				Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
				Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
				Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);
			End;
			Abort If(Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0);
			If(Or(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Global.TextCleanupIndex] != 0, Or(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Global.TextCleanupIndex] != 0, Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Global.TextCleanupIndex] != 0)));
				Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
				Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
				Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);
			End;
			Abort If(Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0);
			Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupIndex] = Event Player;
		End;
		Create In-World Text(Filtered Array(Global.LuckVisionViewers, And(Current Array Element != Event Player, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman) == True, Player Variable(Current Array Element, LuckPrivacyActive) == True)))), Custom String("{0} {1} | {2}", Hero Icon String(Is Duplicating(Event Player) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Event Player) : Hero Of(Event Player)), Event Player.IsHuman == True ? Event Player.DisplayName : Custom String("{0}", Event Player), Round To Integer(Health(Event Player), Down)), Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Event Player)) + Vector(0, 0.450, 0)), 1.100, Do Not Clip, Visible To Position String and Color, Event Player.IsHuman == True ? Event Player.NameColor : Color(Orange), Visible Never);
		Event Player.LuckVisionText = Last Text ID;
		Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = Event Player.LuckVisionText;
	}
}

rule("18j - Luck: Clear vision names when no longer needed")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed == False;
		Event Player.PlayerCycleActive == False;
		And(Event Player.LuckVisionText != Null, Event Player.LuckVisionText != 0) == True;
		Or(Is Alive(Event Player) == False, Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.LuckVisionViewers, And(Current Array Element != Event Player, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman) == True, Player Variable(Current Array Element, LuckPrivacyActive) == True))))) == 0) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] == Event Player.LuckVisionText);
				Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.LuckVisionText);
				Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = 0;
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.LuckVisionText = Null;
	}
}

rule("18k - Luck: Show effect and duration HUD while the menu is closed")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;

		Event Player.LuckEffectHud == Null;

	{
		"Register the owner before creating text; do not overwrite another player's resources."
		Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player);
		If(Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0);
			Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);
			If(Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0);
				Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
				Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
				Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);

				Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
				Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
				Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);

			Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupIndex] = Event Player;

Custom String("AIM-STEERED ACCELERATION") : Event Player.LuckEffect == 5 ? Custom String("BURNING: 5% MAX HP/s") : Custom String("HACKED"), Custom String("{0}s LEFT", Max(0, Round To Integer(Event Player.LuckEffectEndTime - Total Time Elapsed, Up)))), Top, 3, Color(White), Color(White), Global.RGB, Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Event Player.LuckEffectHud = Last Text ID;
		Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = Event Player.LuckEffectHud;
	}
}

rule("19 - Crouch Travel: Open five pages while Crouch is held")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed == False;
		Event Player.PlayerCycleActive == False;
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MenuOpen == False;
		Event Player.LuckActive == False;
		Event Player.LuckPrivacyActive == False;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelActive == False;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelEnabled == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.CrouchTravelActive = True;
		Event Player.TravelCommand = 0;
		Event Player.TravelTargets = Empty Array;
		Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate = Null;
		Event Player.LockedTravelType = -1;
		Event Player.LockedTravelTarget = Null;
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
		Call Subroutine(TransitionMenuColor);
		Call Subroutine(DrawTravelMenu);
	}
}

rule("19a - Crouch Travel: Primary Fire advances, Secondary Fire reverses, Interact applies")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed == False;
		Event Player.PlayerCycleActive == False;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelActive == True;
		Event Player.TravelCommand == 0;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == True;
		Or(Or(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire)), Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire))), Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire)));
			Event Player.TravelCommand = 1;
		Else If(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire)));
			Event Player.TravelCommand = 2;
		Else;
			Event Player.TravelCommand = 3;
		End;
	}
}

rule("19c - Crouch Travel: Navigate five pages with Primary and Secondary Fire")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed == False;
		Event Player.PlayerCycleActive == False;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelActive == True;
		Or(Event Player.TravelCommand == 1, Event Player.TravelCommand == 2) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"The same HUD follows the cursor and target; changing pages creates no new resource ID."
		Event Player.TravelCursor = (Event Player.TravelCursor + (Event Player.TravelCommand == 1 ? 1 : 4)) % 5;
		If(And(Event Player.TravelCursor != 2, Event Player.TravelCursor != 3));
			Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate = Null;
			If(Event Player.TravelText != Null);
				If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player) >= 0);
					If(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] == Event Player.TravelText);
						Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TravelText);
						Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = 0;
					End;
				End;
			End;
			Event Player.TravelText = Null;
			Event Player.TravelTextTarget = Null;
			If(Event Player.NameplatesDisabled == True);
				Enable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Event Player);
				Event Player.NameplatesDisabled = False;
			End;
		Else;
			If(Event Player.InspectionText != Null);
				Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.InspectionText);
			End;
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) >= 0);
				If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds));
					Global.InspectionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)] = 0;
				End;
			End;
			Event Player.InspectionText = Null;
			Event Player.InspectionTarget = Null;
			Event Player.InspectionActive = False;
			If(Event Player.TravelText != Null);
				If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player) >= 0);
					If(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] == Event Player.TravelText);
						Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TravelText);
						Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = 0;
					End;
				End;
			End;
			Event Player.TravelText = Null;
			Event Player.TravelTextTarget = Null;
			Call Subroutine(RefreshTravelTarget);
		End;
		Call Subroutine(TransitionMenuColor);
	}
}

rule("19d - Crouch Travel: Recreate the name when the target changes")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Or(Array Contains(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player), Array Contains(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null)) == True;
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelActive == True;
		Or(Event Player.TravelCursor == 2, Event Player.TravelCursor == 3) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == True;
		Or(Event Player.TravelTextTarget != Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate, Or(And(Event Player.TravelText != Null, Or(Entity Exists(Event Player.TravelTextTarget) == False, Or(Has Spawned(Event Player.TravelTextTarget) == False, Or(Is Alive(Event Player.TravelTextTarget) == False, And(And(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player.TravelTextTarget) == False, Player Variable(Event Player.TravelTextTarget, IsAutomaticBot) == False), Or(Player Variable(Event Player.TravelTextTarget, IsHuman) == False, Or(Player Variable(Event Player.TravelTextTarget, InspectionPrivacyActive) == True, Player Variable(Event Player.TravelTextTarget, PlayerListUpdatePending) == True))))))), And(Event Player.TravelText == Null, And(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate != Null, Total Time Elapsed >= Event Player.NextTargetTextTime)))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Register the owner before creating text; do not overwrite another player's resources."
		"Limit combined name creation to four times per second; remove the old name before checking the deadline."
		If(Event Player.TravelText != Null);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player) >= 0);
				If(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] == Event Player.TravelText);
					Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TravelText);
					Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = 0;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.TravelText = Null;
		Event Player.TravelTextTarget = Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate;
		If(Or(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate == Null, Or(Entity Exists(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate) == False, Or(Has Spawned(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate) == False, Or(Is Alive(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate) == False, And(And(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate) == False, Player Variable(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate, IsAutomaticBot) == False), Or(Player Variable(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate, IsHuman) == False, Or(Player Variable(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate, InspectionPrivacyActive) == True, Player Variable(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate, PlayerListUpdatePending) == True))))))));
			Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate = Null;
			Event Player.TravelTextTarget = Null;
			Abort;
		End;
		Abort If(Total Time Elapsed < Event Player.NextTargetTextTime);
		If(Event Player.NameplatesDisabled == False);
			Disable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Event Player);
			Event Player.NameplatesDisabled = True;
		End;
		Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player);
		If(Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0);
			Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);
			If(Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0);
				Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
				Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
				Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);
			End;
			Abort If(Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0);
			If(Or(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Global.TextCleanupIndex] != 0, Or(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Global.TextCleanupIndex] != 0, Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Global.TextCleanupIndex] != 0)));
				Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
				Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
				Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);
			End;
			Abort If(Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0);
			Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupIndex] = Event Player;
		End;
		Event Player.NextTargetTextTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		Create In-World Text(Event Player, Custom String("{0} {1} | {2}", Hero Icon String(Is Duplicating(Evaluate Once(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate)) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Evaluate Once(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate)) : Hero Of(Evaluate Once(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate))), Evaluate Once(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate) == True ? Player Variable(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate, DisplayName) : Custom String("{0}", Is Duplicating(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate) : Hero Of(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate))), Round To Integer(Health(Evaluate Once(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate)), Down)), Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate)) + Vector(0, 0.450, 0)), 1.100, Do Not Clip, Visible To Position String and Color, Evaluate Once(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate) == True ? Player Variable(Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate, NameColor) : Color(Orange)), Visible Never);
		Event Player.TravelText = Last Text ID;
		Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = Event Player.TravelText;
		Event Player.TravelTextTarget = Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate;
	}
}

rule("19e - Crouch Travel: Interact applies the active page")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed == False;
		Event Player.PlayerCycleActive == False;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelActive == True;
		Event Player.TravelCommand == 3;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Traverse a bounded attachment chain before changing it so three or more players cannot form a cycle."
		Event Player.LockedTravelType = Event Player.TravelCursor;
		Event Player.LockedTravelTarget = Null;
		If(Or(Event Player.LockedTravelType == 2, Event Player.LockedTravelType == 3));
			Call Subroutine(RefreshTravelTarget);
			Event Player.LockedTravelTarget = Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate;
		End;
		If(Event Player.LockedTravelType == 0);
			Call Subroutine(TravelToSpawn);
		Else If(Event Player.LockedTravelType == 1);
			Call Subroutine(TravelToObjective);
		Else If(Event Player.LockedTravelType == 2);
			Call Subroutine(TravelToPlayer);
		Else If(Event Player.LockedTravelType == 3);
			Event Player.AttachmentChain = Event Player.LockedTravelTarget;
			Event Player.AttachmentCycleDetected = False;
			For Player Variable(Event Player, AttachmentChainIndex, 0, Count Of(All Players(All Teams)) + 1, 1);
				If(Event Player.AttachmentChain != Null);
					If(Event Player.AttachmentChain == Event Player);
						Event Player.AttachmentCycleDetected = True;
						Event Player.AttachmentChain = Null;
					Else If(Player Variable(Event Player.AttachmentChain, TravelAttachmentActive) == True);
						Event Player.AttachmentChain = Player Variable(Event Player.AttachmentChain, TravelAttachmentTarget);
					Else;
						Event Player.AttachmentChain = Null;
					End;
				End;
			End;
			If(Event Player.AttachmentChain != Null);
				Event Player.AttachmentCycleDetected = True;
			End;
			If(Or(Or(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget == Null, Entity Exists(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) == False), Or(Has Spawned(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) == False, Is Alive(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) == False)));
				Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Attach target unavailable."));
			Else If(Event Player.AttachmentCycleDetected == True);
				Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Attach blocked: no loops allowed!"));
			Else;
				If(Event Player.TravelAttachmentActive == True);
					Detach Players(Event Player);
				End;
				Event Player.TravelAttachmentTarget = Event Player.LockedTravelTarget;
				Event Player.AttachmentOwnerHero = Hero Of(Event Player);
				Event Player.AttachmentTargetHero = Hero Of(Event Player.TravelAttachmentTarget);
				Event Player.TravelAttachmentActive = True;
				Attach Players(Event Player, Event Player.TravelAttachmentTarget, Vector(0, Y Component Of(Eye Position(Event Player.TravelAttachmentTarget)) - Y Component Of(Position Of(Event Player.TravelAttachmentTarget)) + 0.750, 0));
				Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Attached to {0}. CROUCH + RELOAD: detach.", Event Player.TravelAttachmentTarget));
			End;
		Else;
			If(Total Time Elapsed >= Event Player.NextSuicideTime);
				Event Player.NextSuicideTime = Total Time Elapsed + 3;
				Clear Status(Event Player, Unkillable);
				Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
				Kill(Event Player, Null);
			Else;
				Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Self Elimination: ready in {0}s.", Round To Integer(Event Player.NextSuicideTime - Total Time Elapsed, Up)));
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.LockedTravelType = -1;
		Event Player.LockedTravelTarget = Null;
	}
}

{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
