rule("19g - Crouch Travel: Close when Crouch is released")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed == False;
		Event Player.PlayerCycleActive == False;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelActive == True;
		Or(Or(Or(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == False, Event Player.MenuOpen == True), Or(Has Spawned(Event Player) == False, Is Alive(Event Player) == False)), Event Player.LuckPrivacyActive == True) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.MenuHud != Null);
			Destroy HUD Text(Event Player.MenuHud);
		End;
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds));
				Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)] = 0;
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.MenuHud = Null;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelActive = False;
		Event Player.TravelCommand = 0;
		Event Player.TravelTargets = Empty Array;
		Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate = Null;
		If(Event Player.TravelText != Null);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player) >= 0);
				If(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] == Event Player.TravelText);
					Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TravelText);
					Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = 0;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.TravelText = Null;
		Event Player.TravelTextTarget = Null;
		Event Player.LockedTravelType = -1;
		Event Player.LockedTravelTarget = Null;
		If(Event Player.NameplatesDisabled == True);
			Enable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Event Player);
			Event Player.NameplatesDisabled = False;
		End;
		If(Event Player.InspectionText != Null);
			Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.InspectionText);
		End;
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds));
				Global.InspectionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)] = 0;
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.InspectionText = Null;
		Event Player.InspectionTarget = Null;
		Event Player.InspectionTargets = Empty Array;
		Event Player.InspectionActive = False;
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
	}
}

rule("89a - Subroutine: Process fast player state")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessPlayerFastState;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Store the first selection deadline on the player before preparation that requires a spawn."
		"A team change while queued must update the target team and release the previous reservation."
		"Restore immediately when status ends or the hero changes; ordinary maintenance runs once per second."
		"Restore immediately when status ends or the hero changes; ordinary maintenance runs once per second."
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionComplete == False, Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline == 0));
			If(Or(Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer) == Team 1, Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer) == Team 2));
				Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline = Total Time Elapsed + 60;
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer) == True, And(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.DisplayName == Null, Global.ActivePlayer.DisplayName == Custom String("")), Custom String("{0}", Global.ActivePlayer) != Custom String(""))));
			Global.ActivePlayer.DisplayName = Evaluate Once(Custom String("{0}", Global.ActivePlayer));
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerCycleActive == False, And(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer) == False, And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot == False, And(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer) == True, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == False, Global.ActivePlayer.WasPrepared == False))))));
			If(Global.ActivePlayer.DisplayName == Custom String("งูแรร์"));
				Global.ActivePlayer.CustomSoundtrack = Custom String("Draconian");
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.WasPrepared == False);
					Global.ActivePlayer.ColorIndex = 2;
					Global.ActivePlayer.ColorCursor = 2;
					Global.ActivePlayer.NameColor = Global.NameColors[2];
					Global.ActivePlayer.MenuColor = Global.NameColorRGBValues[2];
					Global.ActivePlayer.IconIndex = 23;
					Global.ActivePlayer.IconCursor = 23;
				End;
			End;
			Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman = True;
			Global.ActivePlayer.IsClassified = True;
			Global.ActivePlayer.IsPrepared = True;
			Global.ActivePlayer.WasPrepared = True;
		End;
		If(And(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer) == False, And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot == False, And(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer) == False, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed == False, Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleTargetTeam != Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer))))));
			Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed = True;
			Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerCycleActive = False;
			Global.ActivePlayer.IsPrepared = False;
			Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman = False;
			Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleTargetTeam = Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer);
			Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleDeadline = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			If(Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Global.ActivePlayer);
				Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
				Global.TeamCycleTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Null, And(Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot == False, And(Or(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer) == False, Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerCycleActive == True), And(Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleTargetTeam == Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer), And(Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, And(Total Time Elapsed >= Global.TeamCycleTime, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleDeadline)))))))));
			Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Global.ActivePlayer;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 3, And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount == 0, Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime > 0))))));
			If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending == True, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant == Null, Or(Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant) == False, Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant, IsHuman) == False))));
				Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending = False;
				Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant = Null;
				Global.ActivePlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
				Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
			Else If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime > 0, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime));
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending == True);
					Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant, Custom String("Revenge failed. Debt unchanged."));
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant, LockedRevengeTarget, Null);
					Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending = False;
					Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant = Null;
				Else;
					Call Subroutine(RestoreActivePlayerLuck);
					Global.ActivePlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen == False;
					Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("SKULL failed. Menu restored."));
				End;
				Global.ActivePlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
				Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
			Else If(And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, And(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime)));
				Global.ActivePlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
				Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable);
				Set Damage Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
				Kill(Global.ActivePlayer, Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending == True ? Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant : Null);
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableActive == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending == False, And(And(And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive == True, Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount == 0), Or(And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 3, Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime > 0), And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 5, Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime > Total Time Elapsed))) == False, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == True))))));
			If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableMode == 1, Is In Spawn Room(Global.ActivePlayer) == False));
				If(Or(Has Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable) == False, Or(Hero Of(Global.ActivePlayer) != Global.ActivePlayer.LastHero, Global.SchedulerStep % 20 == Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot % 20)));
					If(Has Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable) == False);
						Set Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Null, Unkillable, 9999);
					End;
					Set Damage Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
					Set Knockback Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
					Enable Movement Collision With Players(Global.ActivePlayer);
				End;
				If(Health(Global.ActivePlayer) >= Max Health(Global.ActivePlayer));
					Set Player Health(Global.ActivePlayer, 1);
				End;
			Else If(Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableMode == 2);
				If(Or(Has Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable) == False, Or(Hero Of(Global.ActivePlayer) != Global.ActivePlayer.LastHero, Global.SchedulerStep % 20 == Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot % 20)));
					If(Has Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable) == False);
						Set Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Null, Unkillable, 9999);
					End;
					Set Damage Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 0);
					Set Knockback Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 0);
					Disable Movement Collision With Players(Global.ActivePlayer);
				End;
				If(Health(Global.ActivePlayer) < Max Health(Global.ActivePlayer));
					Set Player Health(Global.ActivePlayer, Max Health(Global.ActivePlayer));
				End;
			End;
			If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableIcon == Null, Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableIcon) == False));
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableMode == 1);
					Create Icon(All Players(All Teams), Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer), Warning, Visible To and Position, Custom Color(255, 80, 80, 255), True);
				Else;
					Create Icon(All Players(All Teams), Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer), Halo, Visible To and Position, Global.RGB, True);
				End;
				Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableIcon = Last Created Entity;
				If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer));
					Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)]] = Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableIcon;
				End;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("89a2 - Subroutine: Process 3D flight per player at 20 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessPlayerFlight;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Try Your Luck acceleration keeps control of movement; the Fly controller does not overwrite its velocity."
		"Native movement is disabled; 3D impulses control world velocity, including ascent and descent."
		"Preserve the speed ramp while directional input remains active; changing direction does not restart at 100%."
		"Forward input on the Z axis follows aim pitch; backward and sideways movement remain horizontal."
		"100% Fly is 5.5 m/s and 1000% is 55 m/s; diagonal movement is capped while preserving analog input strength."
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot == False, And(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer) == False, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, And(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyModeActive == True, Global.ActivePlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied == True)))))));
			If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 2, Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime > Total Time Elapsed));
				Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
				Global.ActivePlayer.FlyPercent = 100;
				Global.ActivePlayer.FlyDirection = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Global.ActivePlayer.FlyVelocityDelta = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Else;
				Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 0);
				If(Magnitude Of(Vector(X Component Of(Throttle Of(Global.ActivePlayer)), 0, Z Component Of(Throttle Of(Global.ActivePlayer)))) > 0.050);
					If(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime < 0);
						Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime = Total Time Elapsed;
					End;
					Global.ActivePlayer.FlyPercent = Min(1000, 100 + Max(0, Total Time Elapsed - Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime) * 45);
				Else;
					Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
					Global.ActivePlayer.FlyPercent = 100;
				End;
				Global.ActivePlayer.FlyDirection = Facing Direction Of(Global.ActivePlayer) * Max(0, Z Component Of(Throttle Of(Global.ActivePlayer))) + Direction From Angles(Horizontal Facing Angle Of(Global.ActivePlayer), 0) * Min(0, Z Component Of(Throttle Of(Global.ActivePlayer))) + Cross Product(Vector(0, 1, 0), Direction From Angles(Horizontal Facing Angle Of(Global.ActivePlayer), 0)) * X Component Of(Throttle Of(Global.ActivePlayer));
				If(Magnitude Of(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyDirection) > 0.050);
					Global.ActivePlayer.FlyVelocityDelta = Normalize(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyDirection) * 5.500 * Global.ActivePlayer.FlyPercent / 100 * Min(1, Magnitude Of(Throttle Of(Global.ActivePlayer))) - Velocity Of(Global.ActivePlayer);
				Else;
					Global.ActivePlayer.FlyVelocityDelta = Velocity Of(Global.ActivePlayer) * -1;
				End;
				If(Magnitude Of(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyVelocityDelta) > 0.010);
					Apply Impulse(Global.ActivePlayer, Global.ActivePlayer.FlyVelocityDelta, Magnitude Of(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyVelocityDelta), To World, Incorporate Contrary Motion);
				End;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("89b - Subroutine: Process the player cycle at 10 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessPlayerCycle;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Check player aim and recovery at 10 Hz, including during team transitions."
		"Death or a spawn transition restores native physics while preserving both toggles for the next spawn."
		"Release human registration after the HUD is stable."
		"The global scheduler handles human hero changes without adding a new per-player rule."
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot == False, And(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer) == False, Or(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == False, Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == False)))));
			Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
			If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect != 2, Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime <= Total Time Elapsed));
				Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
			End;
			If(Global.ActivePlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied == True);
				Stop Transforming Throttle(Global.ActivePlayer);
				Set Gravity(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
				Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Global.ActivePlayer);
				Global.ActivePlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = False;
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot == False, And(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer) == False, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == True)))));
			If(Global.ActivePlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied == False);
				Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
				If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect != 2, Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime <= Total Time Elapsed));
					Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, Global.ActivePlayer.FlyModeActive == True ? 0 : 100);
				End;
				Stop Transforming Throttle(Global.ActivePlayer);
				Set Gravity(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
				Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Global.ActivePlayer);
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.GhostModeActive == True);
					Disable Movement Collision With Environment(Global.ActivePlayer, False);
				End;
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyModeActive == True);
					Set Gravity(Global.ActivePlayer, 0);
				End;
				Global.ActivePlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = True;
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == True)));
			If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen == False, And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckPrivacyActive == False, And(Global.ActivePlayer.CrouchTravelActive == False, And(Global.ActivePlayer.CrouchTravelEnabled == False, And(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraMode != 2, Is Button Held(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Crouch)) == True))))));
				Call Subroutine(RefreshActivePlayerPublicTargets);
				Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, InspectionTargetCandidate, Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets) == 0 ? Null : First Of(Sorted Array(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets, Angle Between Vectors(Facing Direction Of(Global.ActivePlayer), Direction Towards(Eye Position(Global.ActivePlayer), Eye Position(Current Array Element))))));
			Else;
				Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, InspectionTargetCandidate, Null);
			End;
			If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.CrouchTravelActive == True, And(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.TravelCursor == 2, Global.ActivePlayer.TravelCursor == 3), Is Button Held(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Crouch)) == True)));
				Call Subroutine(RefreshActivePlayerPublicTargets);
				Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, TravelTargets, Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets);
				Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, TravelTargetCandidate, Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.TravelTargets) == 0 ? Null : First Of(Sorted Array(Global.ActivePlayer.TravelTargets, Angle Between Vectors(Facing Direction Of(Global.ActivePlayer), Direction Towards(Eye Position(Global.ActivePlayer), Eye Position(Current Array Element))))));
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerHudCreated == True))));
			Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed = False;
			Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerCycleActive = False;
			Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleDeadline = 0;
			If(Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Global.ActivePlayer);
				Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
				Global.TeamCycleTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			End;
		End;
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraMode == 2);
			If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget.PlayerCycleActive == True, Or(Or(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget == Null, Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget) == False), Or(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget) == False, Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget) == False)), And(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget.IsHuman == True, Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget.InspectionPrivacyActive == True))));
				Stop Camera(Global.ActivePlayer);
				Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraMode, 0);
				Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraTarget, Null);
				Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("Camera target unavailable/private."));
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, Hero Of(Global.ActivePlayer) != Global.ActivePlayer.LastHero)));
			Global.ActivePlayer.LastHero = Hero Of(Global.ActivePlayer);
			Global.ActivePlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = False;
			Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
			If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect != 2, Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime <= Total Time Elapsed));
				Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
			End;
			If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive == True, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount > 0, Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect != 0)));
				Call Subroutine(RestoreActivePlayerLuck);
				Global.ActivePlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen == False;
			End;
			If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraMode != 0, And(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget != Null, Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget))));
				Stop Camera(Global.ActivePlayer);
				Global.CameraPlayer = Global.ActivePlayer;
				Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
				Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionActive == True, Or(Or(Or(Or(Or(Or(Is Button Held(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Crouch)) == False, Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen == True), Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == False), Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == False), Global.ActivePlayer.CameraMode == 2), And(Global.ActivePlayer.CrouchTravelActive == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.TravelCursor != 2, Global.ActivePlayer.TravelCursor != 3))), Global.ActivePlayer.LuckPrivacyActive == True)));
			If(Global.ActivePlayer.NameplatesDisabled == True);
				Enable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Global.ActivePlayer);
				Global.ActivePlayer.NameplatesDisabled = False;
			End;
			If(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionText != Null);
				Destroy In-World Text(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionText);
			End;
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer) >= 0);
				If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer) < Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds));
					Global.InspectionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)] = 0;
				End;
			End;
			Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionText = Null;
			Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTarget = Null;
			Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets = Empty Array;
			Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionActive = False;
		End;
	}
}

rule("89b2 - Subroutine: Maintain bots at 10 Hz and follow targets at 5 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessPlayerBot;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Release automatic bots after classification and locking finish."
		If(Global.SchedulerStep % 4 == Slot Of(Global.ActivePlayer) % 4);
			If(And(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == True)));
				Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, InspectionTargets, Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, AllowDummyBotFollow) == True, And(Has Spawned(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), Team Of(Current Array Element) == Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer)))))))));
				If(Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets) > 0);
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, DummyBotFollowTarget, First Of(Sorted Array(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets, Distance Between(Global.ActivePlayer, Current Array Element))));
				Else;
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, DummyBotFollowTarget, Null);
				End;
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsClassified == True, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, And(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, Global.ActivePlayer.BotLocked == True))))));
			Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed = False;
			Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerCycleActive = False;
			Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleDeadline = 0;
			If(Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Global.ActivePlayer);
				Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
				Global.TeamCycleTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.IsReady == True, And(Or(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer), Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot) == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.BotLocked == True, Or(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == False, Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == False)))));
			Global.ActivePlayer.BotLocked = False;
		End;
	}
}

rule("89c - Subroutine: Process player maintenance at 1 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessPlayerMaintenance;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer)));
			If(Global.ActivePlayer.AllowDummyBotFollow == True);
				If(Is True For Any(All Players(Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer))), And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) == False);
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, AllowDummyBotFollow, False);
				End;
			End;
			If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen == True, Global.ActivePlayer.MenuPage == 2));
				If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraCursor >= 2, Global.ActivePlayer.CameraCursor - 2 < Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargets)));
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraTargetCandidate, Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargets[Global.ActivePlayer.CameraCursor - 2]);
				Else;
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraTargetCandidate, Null);
				End;
				Call Subroutine(RefreshActivePlayerPublicTargets);
				Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraTargets, Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets);
				If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargetCandidate != Null, Array Contains(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargets, Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargetCandidate)));
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraCursor, Index Of Array Value(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargets, Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargetCandidate) + 2);
				Else If(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraCursor >= Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargets) + 2);
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraCursor, 0);
				End;
			End;
			If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen == True, Global.ActivePlayer.MenuPage == 4));
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeCursor < Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeTargets));
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, SelectedRevengeTarget, Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeTargets[Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeCursor]);
				Else;
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, SelectedRevengeTarget, Null);
				End;
				Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, RevengeTargets, Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, Current Array Element != Global.ActivePlayer));
				If(Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeTargets) == 0);
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, RevengeCursor, 0);
				Else If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.SelectedRevengeTarget != Null, Array Contains(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeTargets, Global.ActivePlayer.SelectedRevengeTarget)));
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, RevengeCursor, Index Of Array Value(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeTargets, Global.ActivePlayer.SelectedRevengeTarget));
				Else If(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeCursor >= Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeTargets));
					Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, RevengeCursor, 0);
				End;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("89d - Subroutine: Process the Try Your Luck state machine")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessPlayerLuck;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Split icon changes into four fixed slot phases; check result and effect deadlines on every step."
		"Apply the final result once after the last icon finishes, without a per-player wait."
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive == True, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == True))));
			If(And(Global.SchedulerStep % 4 == Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot % 4, And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount > 0, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckSpinTime)));
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon != Null);
					Destroy Icon(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon);
				End;
				Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect = Random Integer(1, 6);
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 1);
					Create Icon(Global.HumanPlayers, Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) + Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) * 4), Eye, Visible To and Position, Color(Aqua), True);
				Else If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 2);
					Create Icon(Global.HumanPlayers, Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) + Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) * 4), Dizzy, Visible To and Position, Color(Violet), True);
				Else If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 3);
					Create Icon(Global.HumanPlayers, Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) + Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) * 4), Skull, Visible To and Position, Custom Color(255, 70, 70, 255), True);
				Else If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 4);
					Create Icon(Global.HumanPlayers, Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) + Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) * 4), Heart, Visible To and Position, Custom Color(70, 255, 110, 255), True);
				Else If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 5);
					Create Icon(Global.HumanPlayers, Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) + Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) * 4), Fire, Visible To and Position, Color(Orange), True);
				Else;
					Create Icon(Global.HumanPlayers, Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) + Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) * 4), Poison 2, Visible To and Position, Custom Color(170, 80, 255, 255), True);
				End;
				Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon = Last Created Entity;
				If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer));
					Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)]] = Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon;
				End;
				Modify Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, LuckSpinCount, Subtract, 1);
				Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckSpinTime = Total Time Elapsed + Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinInterval;
				Modify Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, LuckSpinInterval, Add, 0.045);
			End;
			If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount == 0, And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime == 0, And(Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckSpinTime > 0, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckSpinTime))));
				Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = 0;
				Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckBurnTime = 0;
				Global.ActivePlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = False;
				If(Or(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 1, Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 2), Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 5, Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 6)));
					If(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuHud != Null);
						Destroy HUD Text(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuHud);
					End;
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer) >= 0);
						If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer) < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds));
							Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
					Global.ActivePlayer.MenuHud = Null;
					Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen = False;
					Global.ActivePlayer.MenuInputLocked = False;
					Global.ActivePlayer.MenuCommand = 0;
					Global.ActivePlayer.MenuPage = -1;
					Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Primary Fire));
					Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Secondary Fire));
					Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Interact));
					Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Reload));
					Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Ability 1));
					Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Ability 2));
					Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Ultimate));
				End;
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 1);
					Global.ActivePlayer.LuckPrivacyActive = True;
					Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = Total Time Elapsed + 15;
					Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: ALL PLAYER/BOT NAMES — 15s"));
				Else If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 2);
					Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 1000);
					Start Accelerating(Global.ActivePlayer, Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)), 50, 25, To World, Direction Rate and Max Speed);
					Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = Total Time Elapsed + 10;
					Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Global.ActivePlayer.FlyModeActive == True ? Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: FLIGHT BOOST — 10s") : Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: AIM-STEERED ACCELERATION — 10s"));
				Else If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 3);
					Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: SKULL"));
					Global.ActivePlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = Total Time Elapsed;
					Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = Total Time Elapsed + 5;
				Else If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 4);
					Set Player Health(All Living Players(Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer)), 9999);
					Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: HEART — FULL TEAM HEAL"));
					Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect = 0;
					Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive = False;
				Else If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 5);
					Set Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Null, Burning, 10);
					Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable);
					Set Damage Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
					Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = Total Time Elapsed + 10;
					Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckBurnTime = Total Time Elapsed;
					Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: BURNING — 5% MAX HP/s — 10s"));
				Else;
					Set Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Null, Hacked, 5);
					Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = Total Time Elapsed + 5;
					Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: HACKED — 5s"));
				End;
				Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckSpinTime = 0;
				Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
			End;
		End;
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True);
			If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 5);
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime > Total Time Elapsed);
					If(Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckBurnTime <= Total Time Elapsed);
						If(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True);
							If(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == True);
								Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable);
								Set Damage Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
								Damage(Global.ActivePlayer, Global.ActivePlayer, Max Health(Global.ActivePlayer) * 0.050);
								Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckBurnTime = Total Time Elapsed + 1.000;
							End;
						End;
					End;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True);
			If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive == True);
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount == 0);
					If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime > 0);
						If(Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime);
							Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Burning);
							Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Hacked);
							If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 2);
								Stop Accelerating(Global.ActivePlayer);
								Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
							End;
							If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud != Null);
								If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer) >= 0);
									If(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer)] == Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud);
										Destroy HUD Text(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud);
										Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer)] = 0;
									End;
								End;
							End;
							Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud = Null;
							Global.ActivePlayer.LuckPrivacyActive = False;
							Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect = 0;
							Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = 0;
							Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckBurnTime = 0;
							Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive = False;
							Global.ActivePlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = True;
						End;
					End;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime > 0);
			If(Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime);
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon != Null);
					Destroy Icon(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon);
				End;
				Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon = Null;
				If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer));
					Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)]] = 0;
				End;
				Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime = 0;
				If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive == False);
					If(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen == False);
						Global.ActivePlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = True;
					End;
				End;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("90 - Subroutine: Close the menu and restore buttons")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		CloseMenu;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Clear the main resource ID even if the local HUD variable disappears during a transition."
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds));
				If(Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)] != 0);
					Destroy HUD Text(Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)]);
					If(Event Player.MenuHud == Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)]);
						Event Player.MenuHud = Null;
					End;
				End;
				Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)] = 0;
			End;
		End;
		If(Event Player.MenuHud != Null);
			Destroy HUD Text(Event Player.MenuHud);
		End;
		Event Player.MenuHud = Null;
		Event Player.MenuOpen = False;
		Event Player.MenuCommand = 0;
		Event Player.MenuPage = -1;
		If(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Melee)));
			Event Player.MeleeConsumed = True;
		Else;
			Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Melee));
			Event Player.MeleeConsumed = False;
		End;
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Jump));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Crouch));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("91 - Subroutine: Draw one active menu HUD")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		DrawMenu;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.MenuHud != Null);
			Destroy HUD Text(Event Player.MenuHud);
			Event Player.MenuHud = Null;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(DrawActiveMenuPage);
		Call Subroutine(TransitionMenuColor);
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds));
				Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)] = Event Player.MenuHud;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("91g - Subroutine: Draw the Travel menu")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		DrawTravelMenu;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.MenuHud != Null);
			Destroy HUD Text(Event Player.MenuHud);
		End;
		Event Player.MenuHud = Null;
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds));
				Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)] = 0;
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.TravelCursor %= 5;
		Create HUD Text(Event Player, Null, Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("Hold {0} / release: close", Input Binding String(Button(Crouch))), Custom String("{0}: next / {1}: prev", Input Binding String(Button(Primary Fire)), Input Binding String(Button(Secondary Fire)))), Custom String("{0}: use / {1}+{2}: detach", Input Binding String(Button(Interact)), Input Binding String(Button(Crouch)), Input Binding String(Button(Reload)))), Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Event Player.TravelCursor == 0 ? Custom String("1/5 | TELEPORT: SPAWN ROOM") : Event Player.TravelCursor == 1 ? Custom String("2/5 | TELEPORT: OBJECTIVE") : Event Player.TravelCursor == 2 ? Custom String("3/5 | TELEPORT TO PLAYER/BOT") : Event Player.TravelCursor == 3 ? Custom String("4/5 | ATTACH TO PLAYER/BOT") : Custom String("5/5 | SELF ELIMINATION"), Event Player.TravelCursor == 0 ? Custom String("TEAM SPAWN") : Event Player.TravelCursor == 1 ? Custom String("") : Event Player.TravelCursor == 2 ? Custom String("BESIDE: {0}", Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate != Null ? Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate : Custom String("NO PUBLIC TARGET AVAILABLE")) : Event Player.TravelCursor == 3 ? Custom String("ABOVE: {0}", Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate != Null ? Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate : Custom String("NO PUBLIC TARGET AVAILABLE")) : Custom String("CURRENT HERO FORM | COOLDOWN: 3s")), Top, 3, Color(White), Custom Color(190 + X Component Of(Event Player.MenuColor) * 0.250, 190 + Y Component Of(Event Player.MenuColor) * 0.250, 190 + Z Component Of(Event Player.MenuColor) * 0.250, 255), Custom Color(X Component Of(Event Player.MenuColor), Y Component Of(Event Player.MenuColor), Z Component Of(Event Player.MenuColor), 255), Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Event Player.MenuHud = Last Text ID;
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds));
				Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)] = Event Player.MenuHud;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("91n - Subroutine: Draw the Luck card")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		DrawLuckMenu;
	}

	actions
	{

Custom String("WATCH IT SPIN") : Custom String("GIVE IT A SPIN"))), Top, 3, Color(White), Custom Color(255, 240, 190, 255), Custom Color(X Component Of(Event Player.MenuColor), Y Component Of(Event Player.MenuColor), Z Component Of(Event Player.MenuColor), 255), Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Event Player.MenuHud = Last Text ID;

		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 5);

		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 6);
			Call Subroutine(DrawHeroVoiceMenu);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 7);
			Call Subroutine(DrawPlayerIconMenu);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 10);
			Call Subroutine(DrawLuckMenu);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 11);
			Call Subroutine(DrawVoteMenu);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 13);
			Call Subroutine(DrawGhostFlyMenu);
		Else If(Event Player.MenuPage == 14);
			Call Subroutine(DrawMultijumpMenu);
		End;
	}

rule("92 - Subroutine: Lock the bot while allowing movement")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		LockBot;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Is Alive(Event Player) == False);
		Event Player.MenuOpen = False;
		Event Player.MeleeConsumed = False;
		Event Player.MenuPage = -1;
		Set Primary Fire Enabled(Event Player, False);
		Set Secondary Fire Enabled(Event Player, False);
		Set Ability 1 Enabled(Event Player, False);
		Set Ability 2 Enabled(Event Player, False);
		Set Ultimate Ability Enabled(Event Player, False);
		Set Melee Enabled(Event Player, False);
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 1));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 2));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Ultimate));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Melee));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Jump));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Reload));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
		Set Damage Dealt(Event Player, 0);
		Set Healing Dealt(Event Player, 0);
		Set Knockback Dealt(Event Player, 0);
		Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
		Set Move Speed(Event Player, 20);
		Event Player.LastHero = Hero Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.DummyBotFollowTarget = Null;
		Event Player.BotLocked = True;
		Disable Nameplates(Event Player, Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, Player Variable(Current Array Element, NameplatesDisabled) == True));
	}
}

rule("91q - Subroutine: Recount votes and determine a sole leader")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RecountVotes;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Count registered voters only; do not read variables from departed entities."
		For Global Variable(VoterIndex, 0, Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers), 1);
			Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], VoteCount, Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, Player Variable(Current Array Element, VotedPlayer) == Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex])));
		End;
		Global.VoteLeader = Null;
		Global.HighestVoteCount = 0;
		Global.VoteTied = False;
		Global.VoteLeaderName = Custom String("");
		Global.VoteLeaderColor = Color(White);
		If(Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers) > 0);
			Global.VoteLeader = First Of(Sorted Array(Global.HumanPlayers, 0 - Player Variable(Current Array Element, VoteCount)));
			Global.HighestVoteCount = Player Variable(Global.VoteLeader, VoteCount);
			If(Global.HighestVoteCount > 0);
				Global.VoteTied = Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, Player Variable(Current Array Element, VoteCount) == Global.HighestVoteCount)) > 1;
				If(Global.VoteTied == True);
					Global.VoteLeader = Null;
				End;
			Else;
				Global.VoteLeader = Null;
			End;
		End;
		If(Global.VoteLeader != Null);
			Global.VoteLeaderName = Player Variable(Global.VoteLeader, DisplayName);
			Global.VoteLeaderColor = Player Variable(Global.VoteLeader, NameColor);
		End;
	}
}

rule("93 - Subroutine: Start the dynamic left shoulder camera")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		StartCamera;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Follow target movement every frame without smoothing that chases a moving destination and causes jitter."
		Abort If(Global.CameraPlayer == Null);
		Abort If(Entity Exists(Global.CameraPlayer) == False);
		Abort If(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraMode == 0);
		Abort If(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget == Null);
		Abort If(Entity Exists(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) == False);
		Start Camera(Global.CameraPlayer, Update Every Frame(First Of(Mapped Array(Array(Ray Cast Hit Position(Eye Position(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) + Vector(0, Min(0.750, Max(0.450, 0.450 + (Max Health(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) - 200) * 0.0006)), 0), Eye Position(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) + Vector(0, Min(0.750, Max(0.450, 0.450 + (Max Health(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) - 200) * 0.0006)), 0) - Facing Direction Of(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) * Min(4.500, Max(Global.CameraDistance, Global.CameraDistance + (Max Health(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) - 200) * 0.0055)) + Cross Product(Direction From Angles(Horizontal Facing Angle Of(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget), 0), Vector(0, 1, 0)) * Min(1.350, Max(Global.CameraOffset, Global.CameraOffset + (Max Health(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) - 200) * 0.0016)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False)), Current Array Element + Direction Towards(Current Array Element, Eye Position(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) + Vector(0, Min(0.750, Max(0.450, 0.450 + (Max Health(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) - 200) * 0.0006)), 0)) * Min(Global.CameraWallPadding, Distance Between(Current Array Element, Eye Position(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) + Vector(0, Min(0.750, Max(0.450, 0.450 + (Max Health(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) - 200) * 0.0006)), 0)) * 0.250)))), Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) + Facing Direction Of(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget) * Global.AimDistance), 0);
	}
}

rule("93b2 - Subroutine: Quiesce the trigger player before cleanup")

		Subroutine;

	{
		"Restore native effects before preparation clears variables; call only from trigger-player context."

		Event Player.RevengeDeathPending = False;
		Event Player.RevengeClaimant = Null;
		Event Player.IsPrepared = False;
		Event Player.IsHuman = False;
		Event Player.MenuCommand = 0;
		Event Player.MenuInputLocked = False;
		Event Player.MeleeConsumed = False;
		Event Player.MenuOpen = False;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelActive = False;
		Event Player.TravelCommand = 0;

rule("93c - Subroutine: Clear references to players who actually left")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		CleanupPlayer;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Departure cleanup touches only resource IDs and global player lists; departed entities are not normalized again."
		"Cleanup safeguard: mark the fallback path and run emergency recovery after the main path."
		"Remove votes for a departing player before another player can reuse that entity slot."
		"Clear paired Revenge debts and claims before slot references can be reused."
		Global.SuperPunchPlayers = Remove From Array(Global.SuperPunchPlayers, Event Player);
		Global.CleanupSubject = Event Player;
		Call Subroutine(CleanupObjectiveIcon);
		Global.LeavingPlayerIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.CleanupSubject);
		If(Global.LeavingPlayerIndex > -1);
			If(Or(Global.LeavingPlayerIndex >= Count Of(Global.PlayerHudSlots), Or(Global.LeavingPlayerIndex >= Count Of(Global.PlayerListHudIds), Or(Global.LeavingPlayerIndex >= Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds), Global.LeavingPlayerIndex >= Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds)))));
				Global.CleanupPlayerIndex = Global.LeavingPlayerIndex;
				Global.LeavingPlayerIndex = -2;
			End;
			If(Global.LeavingPlayerIndex >= 0);
				Global.CleanupPlayerIndex = Global.LeavingPlayerIndex;
				Global.LeavingDebtIndex = Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex];
				If(Global.LuckIconIds[Global.LeavingDebtIndex] != 0);
					Destroy Icon(Global.LuckIconIds[Global.LeavingDebtIndex]);
				End;
				Global.LuckIconIds[Global.LeavingDebtIndex] = 0;
				If(Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.LeavingDebtIndex] != 0);
					Destroy Icon(Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.LeavingDebtIndex]);
				End;
				Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.LeavingDebtIndex] = 0;
				If(Global.CleanupSubject.LuckEffectHud != Null);
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject) >= 0);
						If(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject)] == Global.CleanupSubject.LuckEffectHud);
							Destroy HUD Text(Global.CleanupSubject.LuckEffectHud);
							Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				End;
				If(Global.CleanupSubject.LuckVisionText != Null);
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject) >= 0);
						If(Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject)] == Global.CleanupSubject.LuckVisionText);
							Destroy In-World Text(Global.CleanupSubject.LuckVisionText);
							Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				End;
				If(Global.CleanupSubject.TravelText != Null);
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject) >= 0);
						If(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject)] == Global.CleanupSubject.TravelText);
							Destroy In-World Text(Global.CleanupSubject.TravelText);
							Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				End;
				Global.CleanupSubject.LuckIcon = Null;
				Global.CleanupSubject.UnkillableIcon = Null;
				Global.CleanupSubject.LuckEffectHud = Null;
				Global.CleanupSubject.LuckVisionText = Null;
				Global.CleanupSubject.TravelText = Null;
				Global.CleanupSubject.PlayerListHud = Null;
				Global.CleanupSubject.MenuHud = Null;
				Global.CleanupSubject.InspectionText = Null;
				Global.CleanupSubject.PlayerHudCreated = False;
				Global.CleanupSubject.IsClassified = False;
				Set Player Variable(Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, Player Variable(Current Array Element, VotedPlayer) == Global.CleanupSubject), VotedPlayer, Null);
				For Global Variable(VoterIndex, 0, Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers), 1);
					If(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex] != Global.CleanupSubject);
						Global.LeavingRevengeIndex = Index Of Array Value(Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeKillers), Global.CleanupSubject);
						If(And(Global.LeavingRevengeIndex >= 0, Global.LeavingRevengeIndex < Count Of(Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeDebts))));
							Modify Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeKillers, Remove From Array By Index, Global.LeavingRevengeIndex);
							Modify Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeDebts, Remove From Array By Index, Global.LeavingRevengeIndex);
						End;
						If(Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], LockedRevengeTarget) == Global.CleanupSubject);
							Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], LockedRevengeTarget, Null);
						End;
						If(Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], SelectedRevengeTarget) == Global.CleanupSubject);
							Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], SelectedRevengeTarget, Null);
						End;
						If(Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeClaimant) == Global.CleanupSubject);
							Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeClaimant, Null);
							Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeDeathPending, False);
							Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], NextForcedRevengeTime, 0);
							Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], ForcedRevengeEndTime, 0);
						End;
					End;
				End;
				If(Global.PlayerListHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex] != 0);
					Destroy HUD Text(Global.PlayerListHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]);
				End;
				If(Global.MenuHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex] != 0);
					Destroy HUD Text(Global.MenuHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]);
				End;
				If(Global.InspectionTextIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex] != 0);
					Destroy In-World Text(Global.InspectionTextIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]);
				End;
				Global.AvailableHudSlots = Sorted Array(Append To Array(Global.AvailableHudSlots, Global.LeavingDebtIndex), Current Array Element);
				Modify Global Variable(PlayerListHudIds, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
				Modify Global Variable(MenuHudIds, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
				Modify Global Variable(InspectionTextIds, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
				Modify Global Variable(PlayerHudSlots, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
				Modify Global Variable(HumanPlayers, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
				Global.VoterIndex = Count Of(Global.PlayerHudSlots);
				Global.LastHudSlot = Global.VoterIndex == 0 ? -1 : Last Of(Sorted Array(Global.PlayerHudSlots, Current Array Element));
				Global.VoteRecountNeeded = True;
			End;
			If(Global.LeavingPlayerIndex == -2);
				If(Global.CleanupPlayerIndex < Count Of(Global.PlayerHudSlots));
					Destroy Icon(Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]]);
					Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]] = 0;
				End;
				If(Global.CleanupPlayerIndex < Count Of(Global.PlayerHudSlots));
					Destroy Icon(Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]]);
					Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]] = 0;
				End;
				If(Event Player.LuckEffectHud != Null);
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player) >= 0);
						If(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] == Event Player.LuckEffectHud);
							Destroy HUD Text(Event Player.LuckEffectHud);
							Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				End;
				If(Event Player.LuckVisionText != Null);
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player) >= 0);
						If(Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] == Event Player.LuckVisionText);
							Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.LuckVisionText);
							Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				End;
				If(Event Player.TravelText != Null);
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player) >= 0);
						If(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] == Event Player.TravelText);
							Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TravelText);
							Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				End;
				Event Player.LuckIcon = Null;
				Event Player.UnkillableIcon = Null;
				Event Player.LuckEffectHud = Null;
				Event Player.LuckVisionText = Null;
				Event Player.TravelText = Null;
				Event Player.PlayerListHud = Null;
				Event Player.MenuHud = Null;
				Event Player.InspectionText = Null;
				Event Player.PlayerHudCreated = False;
				Event Player.IsClassified = False;
				If(Global.CleanupPlayerIndex < Count Of(Global.PlayerListHudIds));
					If(Global.PlayerListHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex] != 0);
						Destroy HUD Text(Global.PlayerListHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]);
					End;
					Modify Global Variable(PlayerListHudIds, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
				End;
				If(Global.CleanupPlayerIndex < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds));
					If(Global.MenuHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex] != 0);
						Destroy HUD Text(Global.MenuHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]);
					End;
					Modify Global Variable(MenuHudIds, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
				End;
				If(Global.CleanupPlayerIndex < Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds));
					If(Global.InspectionTextIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex] != 0);
						Destroy In-World Text(Global.InspectionTextIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]);
					End;
					Modify Global Variable(InspectionTextIds, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
				End;
				If(Global.CleanupPlayerIndex < Count Of(Global.PlayerHudSlots));
					Global.LeavingDebtIndex = Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex];
					Modify Global Variable(PlayerHudSlots, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
					Global.AvailableHudSlots = Append To Array(Global.AvailableHudSlots, Global.LeavingDebtIndex);
					Global.AvailableHudSlots = Sorted Array(Global.AvailableHudSlots, Current Array Element);
				End;
				Modify Global Variable(HumanPlayers, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
				Global.VoterIndex = Count Of(Global.PlayerHudSlots);
				Global.LastHudSlot = Global.VoterIndex == 0 ? -1 : Last Of(Sorted Array(Global.PlayerHudSlots, Current Array Element));
				Global.VoteRecountNeeded = True;
			End;
		End;
		Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Event Player;
		Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
		Global.LeavingPlayerIndex = -1;
		Global.CleanupPlayerIndex = -1;
		Global.LeavingDebtIndex = -1;
		Global.LeavingRevengeIndex = -1;
		Global.VoterIndex = 0;
		Global.CleanupSubject = Null;
	}
}

rule("93d - Subroutine: Clean up orphaned text")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		CleanupOrphanedText;
	}

	actions
	{
		"The fixed 24-slot registry covers humans and bots; resource IDs remain available after entities disappear."
		For Global Variable(TextCleanupCursor, 0, Count Of(Global.TemporaryTextOwners), 1);
			If(Or(Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != Null, Or(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != 0, Or(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != 0, Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != 0))));
				If(Or(Entity Exists(Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupCursor]) == False, And(Global.TextCleanupPlayer != Null, Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupCursor] == Global.TextCleanupPlayer)));
					If(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != 0);
						Destroy HUD Text(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor]);
					End;
					If(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != 0);
						Destroy In-World Text(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor]);
					End;
					If(Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != 0);
						Destroy In-World Text(Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor]);
					End;
					Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] = 0;
					Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] = 0;
					Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] = 0;
					Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupCursor] = Null;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
		Global.TextCleanupIndex = -1;
		Global.TextCleanupCursor = 0;
	}
}

rule("94 - Subroutine: Prepare the player and initialize variables")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		PreparePlayer;
	}

	actions
	{
		"The preparation worker accepts spawned players only; do not restart the deadline during a team change."
		Abort If(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player));
		Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
		Stop Accelerating(Event Player);
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Event Player);
		Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Set Gravity(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player);
		Event Player.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline = 0;
		Event Player.AutoHeroSelectionComplete = True;
		Event Player.IsClassified = False;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot = False;
		Event Player.IsHuman = False;
		Event Player.GenreIndex = -1;
		Event Player.CustomSoundtrack = Null;
		Event Player.PlayerListUpdatePending = False;
		If(Or(Event Player.DisplayName == Null, Event Player.DisplayName == Custom String("")));
			Event Player.DisplayName = Null;
		End;
		Event Player.HudSlot = -1;
		Event Player.PlayerListHud = Null;
		Event Player.PlayerHudCreated = False;
		Event Player.MenuOpen = False;
		Event Player.GenreCursor = 0;
		Event Player.MenuHud = Null;
		Event Player.InspectionActive = False;
		Event Player.NextTargetTextTime = 0;
		Event Player.InspectionTarget = Null;
		Event Player.InspectionText = Null;
		Event Player.CameraMode = 0;
		Event Player.CameraTarget = Null;
		Event Player.MeleeConsumed = False;
		Event Player.MenuPage = -1;
		Event Player.MainMenuCursor = 0;
		Event Player.CameraCursor = 0;
		Event Player.ColorCursor = 0;
		Event Player.ColorIndex = 0;
		Event Player.NameColor = Color(White);
		Event Player.CameraTargetCandidate = Null;
		Event Player.CameraTargets = Empty Array;
		Event Player.RevengeCursor = 0;
		Event Player.RevengeTargets = Empty Array;
		Event Player.RevengeKillers = Empty Array;
		Event Player.RevengeDebts = Empty Array;
		Event Player.RevengeIndex = -1;
		Event Player.RevengeDeathPending = False;
		Event Player.RevengeClaimant = Null;
		Event Player.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
		Event Player.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
		Event Player.TravelCursor = 0;
		Event Player.TravelTargets = Empty Array;
		Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate = Null;
		Event Player.TravelTextTarget = Null;
		Event Player.TravelText = Null;
		Event Player.MenuInputLocked = False;
		Event Player.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
		Event Player.SelectedRevengeTarget = Null;
		Event Player.NameplatesDisabled = False;
		Event Player.BotLocked = False;
		Event Player.LastHero = Null;
		Event Player.InspectionTargets = Empty Array;
		Event Player.MenuCommand = 0;
		Event Player.LockedTravelType = -1;
		Event Player.LockedTravelTarget = Null;
		Event Player.UnkillableActive = False;
		Event Player.UnkillableCursor = 0;
		Event Player.VoiceIndex = 0;
		Event Player.VoiceCursor = 0;
		Event Player.CrouchTravelActive = False;
		Event Player.TravelCommand = 0;
		Event Player.CameraInteractConsumed = False;
		Event Player.DeathPosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Event Player.ReviveTeleportNeeded = False;
		Event Player.JumpReviveConsumed = False;
		Event Player.IconIndex = 0;
		Event Player.IconCursor = 0;
		Event Player.MenuColor = Vector(255, 255, 255);
		Event Player.CrouchTravelEnabled = False;
		Event Player.InspectionPrivacyActive = False;
		Event Player.UnkillableMode = 0;
		Event Player.UnkillableIcon = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player));
			Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)]] = 0;
		End;
		Event Player.LuckActive = False;
		Event Player.LuckIcon = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player));
			Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)]] = 0;
		End;
		Event Player.VoteCursor = 0;
		Event Player.VotedPlayer = Null;
		Event Player.VoteCount = 0;
		Event Player.LuckSpinCount = 0;
		Event Player.LuckSpinInterval = 0;
		Event Player.LuckEffect = 0;
		Event Player.LuckEffectEndTime = 0;
		Event Player.LuckPrivacyActive = False;
		Event Player.NextLuckBurnTime = 0;
		Event Player.NextLuckSpinTime = 0;
		Event Player.LuckIconEndTime = 0;
		Event Player.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = False;
		Event Player.LuckEffectHud = Null;
		Event Player.LuckVisionText = Null;
		Event Player.LastTeam = Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.TeamCycleTargetTeam = Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.DummyBotTravelTime = 0;
		Event Player.DummyBotTravelCursor = 0;

		Event Player.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = False;
		Event Player.NextSuicideTime = 0;
