rule("95 - Subroutine: Refresh camera targets, including bots")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RefreshCameraTargets;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And(Event Player.CameraCursor >= 2, Event Player.CameraCursor - 2 < Count Of(Event Player.CameraTargets)));
			Event Player.CameraTargetCandidate = Event Player.CameraTargets[Event Player.CameraCursor - 2];
		Else;
			Event Player.CameraTargetCandidate = Null;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(RefreshPlayerPublicTargets);
		Event Player.CameraTargets = Filtered Array(Event Player.InspectionTargets, Has Spawned(Current Array Element) == True);
		If(And(Event Player.CameraTargetCandidate != Null, Array Contains(Event Player.CameraTargets, Event Player.CameraTargetCandidate)));
			Event Player.CameraCursor = Index Of Array Value(Event Player.CameraTargets, Event Player.CameraTargetCandidate) + 2;
		Else If(Event Player.CameraCursor >= Count Of(Event Player.CameraTargets) + 2);
			Event Player.CameraCursor = 0;
		End;
	}
}

rule("96 - Subroutine: Find the nearest public inspection target under the crosshair")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RefreshInspectionTarget;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Or(Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate == Null, Or(Entity Exists(Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate) == False, Or(Has Spawned(Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate) == False, Or(Is Alive(Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate) == False, And(And(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate) == False, Player Variable(Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate, IsAutomaticBot) == False), Or(Player Variable(Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate, IsHuman) == False, Or(Player Variable(Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate, InspectionPrivacyActive) == True, Player Variable(Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate, PlayerListUpdatePending) == True))))))));
			Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate = Null;
			Event Player.InspectionTarget = Null;
		Else;
			Event Player.InspectionTarget = Event Player.InspectionTargetCandidate;
		End;
	}
}

rule("97 - Subroutine: Refresh Revenge targets")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RefreshRevengeTargets;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.RevengeCursor < Count Of(Event Player.RevengeTargets));
			Event Player.SelectedRevengeTarget = Event Player.RevengeTargets[Event Player.RevengeCursor];
		Else;
			Event Player.SelectedRevengeTarget = Null;
		End;
		Event Player.RevengeTargets = Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, Current Array Element != Event Player);
		If(Count Of(Event Player.RevengeTargets) == 0);
			Event Player.RevengeCursor = 0;
		Else If(And(Event Player.SelectedRevengeTarget != Null, Array Contains(Event Player.RevengeTargets, Event Player.SelectedRevengeTarget)));
			Event Player.RevengeCursor = Index Of Array Value(Event Player.RevengeTargets, Event Player.SelectedRevengeTarget);
		Else If(Event Player.RevengeCursor >= Count Of(Event Player.RevengeTargets));
			Event Player.RevengeCursor = 0;
		End;
	}
}

rule("98 - Subroutine: Find the nearest public Travel target under the crosshair")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RefreshTravelTarget;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(RefreshPlayerPublicTargets);
		Event Player.TravelTargets = Event Player.InspectionTargets;
		If(Count Of(Event Player.TravelTargets) == 0);
			Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate = Null;
		Else;
			Event Player.TravelTargetCandidate = First Of(Sorted Array(Event Player.TravelTargets, Angle Between Vectors(Facing Direction Of(Event Player), Direction Towards(Eye Position(Event Player), Eye Position(Current Array Element)))));
		End;
	}
}

rule("98a - Subroutine: Restore Luck state for the trigger player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RestorePlayerLuck;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.LuckIcon != Null);
			Destroy Icon(Event Player.LuckIcon);
		End;
		If(Event Player.LuckEffectHud != Null);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player) >= 0);
				If(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] == Event Player.LuckEffectHud);
					Destroy HUD Text(Event Player.LuckEffectHud);
					Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = 0;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		If(Event Player.LuckVisionText != Null);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player) >= 0);
				If(Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] == Event Player.LuckVisionText);
					Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.LuckVisionText);
					Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Event Player)] = 0;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.LuckIcon = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player));
			Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player)]] = 0;
		End;
		Event Player.LuckEffectHud = Null;
		Event Player.LuckVisionText = Null;
		Clear Status(Event Player, Burning);
		Clear Status(Event Player, Hacked);
		Clear Status(Event Player, Unkillable);
		If(Event Player.LuckEffect == 2);
			Stop Accelerating(Event Player);
			Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
		End;
		Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
		Set Jump Vertical Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Set Projectile Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Event Player.LuckActive = False;
		Event Player.LuckSpinCount = 0;
		Event Player.LuckSpinInterval = 0;
		Event Player.LuckEffect = 0;
		Event Player.LuckEffectEndTime = 0;
		Event Player.LuckPrivacyActive = False;
		Event Player.NextLuckBurnTime = 0;
		Event Player.NextLuckSpinTime = 0;
		Event Player.LuckIconEndTime = 0;
		Event Player.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
		Event Player.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
		Event Player.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = False;
		Event Player.UnkillableActive = Event Player.UnkillableMode != 0;
		Event Player.MenuInputLocked = False;
		Event Player.MenuCommand = 0;
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("98b - Subroutine: Restore Luck state for the globally active player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RestoreActivePlayerLuck;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer == Null, Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer) == False));
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon != Null);
			Destroy Icon(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon);
		End;
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud != Null);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer) >= 0);
				If(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer)] == Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud);
					Destroy HUD Text(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud);
					Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer)] = 0;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckVisionText != Null);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer) >= 0);
				If(Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer)] == Global.ActivePlayer.LuckVisionText);
					Destroy In-World Text(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckVisionText);
					Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer)] = 0;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer));
			Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)]] = 0;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud = Null;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckVisionText = Null;
		Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Burning);
		Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Hacked);
		If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableMode == 0, Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == False));
			Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable);
			Set Damage Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
			Set Knockback Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
			Enable Movement Collision With Players(Global.ActivePlayer);
		End;
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 2);
			Stop Accelerating(Global.ActivePlayer);
			Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		End;
		Set Jump Vertical Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Set Projectile Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinInterval = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckPrivacyActive = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckBurnTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckSpinTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableActive = Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableMode != 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.MenuInputLocked = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.MenuCommand = 0;
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("98c - Subroutine: Refresh public targets for the trigger player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RefreshPlayerPublicTargets;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.InspectionTargets = Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Current Array Element != Event Player, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), Or(Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True, Or(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsAutomaticBot) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, InspectionPrivacyActive) == False, Player Variable(Current Array Element, PlayerListUpdatePending) == False))))))));
	}
}

rule("98d - Subroutine: Refresh public targets for the globally active player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RefreshActivePlayerPublicTargets;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer == Null, Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer) == False));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, InspectionTargets, Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Current Array Element != Global.ActivePlayer, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), Or(Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True, Or(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsAutomaticBot) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, InspectionPrivacyActive) == False, Player Variable(Current Array Element, PlayerListUpdatePending) == False)))))))));
	}
}

rule("98e - Subroutine: Create a dummy bot for the active team")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		CreateTeamDummyBot;
	}

	actions
	{
		Create Dummy Bot(All Heroes, Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam, -1, Position Of(First Of(Spawn Points(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam))), Vector(0, 0, 1));
	}
}

rule("98f - Subroutine: Remove a dummy bot from the active team")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RemoveTeamDummyBot;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) == 0);
		If(Player Variable(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)), LuckVisionText) != Null);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True))) >= 0);
				If(Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)))] == Player Variable(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)), LuckVisionText));
					Destroy In-World Text(Player Variable(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)), LuckVisionText));
					Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)))] = 0;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		Stop Facing(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)));
		Stop Throttle In Direction(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)));
		Destroy Dummy Bot(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam, Slot Of(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True))));
	}
}

rule("98g - Subroutine: Travel to spawn")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TravelToSpawn;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Is In Spawn Room(Event Player) == True);
			Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Already in Spawn Room. Home sweet home!"));
		Else If(Count Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Event Player))) == 0);
			Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Spawn Room unavailable."));
		Else;
			If(Event Player.CameraMode != 0);
				Stop Camera(Event Player);
			End;
			Teleport(Event Player, Position Of(First Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Event Player)))));
			If(Event Player.CameraMode != 0);
				Global.CameraPlayer = Event Player;
				Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
				Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("98h - Subroutine: Travel to the objective")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TravelToObjective;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.TravelDestination = Objective Position(Objective Index);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.TravelDestination, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Objective unavailable."));
			Abort;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("No safe walkable spot near the objective."));
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Event Player.CameraMode != 0);
			Stop Camera(Event Player);
		End;
		Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.SafeRevivePosition);
		If(Event Player.CameraMode != 0);
			Global.CameraPlayer = Event Player;
			Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
			Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
		End;
	}
}

rule("98i - Subroutine: Travel to the target player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TravelToPlayer;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Or(Or(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget == Null, Entity Exists(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) == False), Or(Is Alive(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) == False, Array Contains(Event Player.TravelTargets, Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) == False)));
			Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Target unavailable. Teleport has standards."));
			Abort;
		End;
		Event Player.TravelDestination = Position Of(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) - Facing Direction Of(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) * 2.250;
		Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.TravelDestination = Position Of(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) + Facing Direction Of(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) * 2.250;
			Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.TravelDestination = Position Of(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) + Vector(2.250, 0, 0);
			Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.TravelDestination = Position Of(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) + Vector(-2.250, 0, 0);
			Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.TravelDestination = Position Of(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) + Vector(0, 0, 2.250);
			Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.TravelDestination = Position Of(Event Player.LockedTravelTarget) + Vector(0, 0, -2.250);
			Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("No safe walkable spot near that target."));
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Event Player.CameraMode != 0);
			Stop Camera(Event Player);
		End;
		Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.SafeRevivePosition);
		If(Event Player.CameraMode != 0);
			Global.CameraPlayer = Event Player;
			Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
			Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
		End;
	}
}

rule("98j - Subroutine: Find a safe Travel position")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		FindSafeTravelPosition;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Move the Travel position away from walls before checking ground and the final route."
		"Recheck body and head clearance after all wall corrections; reject narrow positions so the caller can try another."
		Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort If(Distance Between(Event Player.TravelDestination, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
		Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.TravelDestination);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(1.500, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 1.250);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(-1.500, 0, 0));
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(-1.500, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 1.250);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(1.500, 0, 0));
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 1.500), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 1.250);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0, -1.500));
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, -1.500), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 1.250);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0, 1.500));
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(1.000, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 0.850);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(-1.000, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 0.850);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 1.000), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 0.850);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, -1.000), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 0.850);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0.250, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 2.500, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0.250, 0)) < 2.000);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Event Player.TravelDestination) > 8);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 5, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition - Vector(0, 20, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition) > 6);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.TravelDestination + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)) > 0.750);
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(1.500, 1.000, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)) < 1.250);
				Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(-1.500, 1.000, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)) < 1.250);
				Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 1.500), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)) < 1.250);
				Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, -1.500), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)) < 1.250);
				Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0.500, 0), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 2.750, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0.500, 0)) < 2.000);
				Event Player.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			Event Player.SafeRevivePosition += Vector(0, 0.500, 0);
		End;
	}
}

rule("99p - Subroutine: Apply the Multijump choice")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyMultijumpPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		"When the mode is applied, an already held button waits for the cooldown before the next air jump."
		Event Player.MultijumpCursor %= 11;
		Event Player.MultijumpEnabled = Event Player.MultijumpCursor != 0;
		If(Event Player.MultijumpEnabled == True);
			Event Player.MultijumpLevel = Event Player.MultijumpCursor;
		End;
		Event Player.MultijumpConsumed = Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Jump));
		Event Player.JumpWasGrounded = Is On Ground(Event Player);
		Event Player.NextMultijumpTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.300;
	}
}

rule("91t - Subroutine: Draw Multijump choices")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		DrawMultijumpMenu;
	}

	actions
	{
		Create HUD Text(Event Player, Null, Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("Hold {0}", Input Binding String(Button(Crouch))), Custom String("{0}: next / {1}: prev", Input Binding String(Button(Primary Fire)), Input Binding String(Button(Secondary Fire)))), Custom String("{0}: toggle / {1}: back", Input Binding String(Button(Interact)), Input Binding String(Button(Reload)))), Custom String("Hold {0} 0.5s: close", Input Binding String(Button(Melee)))), Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("14 - MULTIJUMP {0}/11", Event Player.MultijumpCursor + 1), Custom String("NOW: {0} | AIR BOOST: {1}%", Event Player.MultijumpEnabled ? Custom String("ON") : Custom String("OFF"), Event Player.MultijumpLevel * 100)), Custom String("> {0}", Event Player.MultijumpCursor == 0 ? Custom String("OFF") : Custom String("AIR BOOST: {0}%", Event Player.MultijumpCursor * 100))), Custom String("> {0}", Event Player.MultijumpCursor == 0 ? Custom String("") : Custom String("IN AIR: TAP / HOLD JUMP"))), Top, 3, Color(White), Custom Color(215, 235, 255, 255), Custom Color(X Component Of(Event Player.MenuColor), Y Component Of(Event Player.MenuColor), Z Component Of(Event Player.MenuColor), 255), Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Event Player.MenuHud = Last Text ID;
	}
}

rule("89h - Subroutine: Repeat air jumps with a cooldown")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessMultijump;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Use fixed vertical velocity correction; holding the button repeats only in the air every 0.300 seconds."
		If(Is Button Held(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Jump)) == True);
			If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpConsumed == False, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.NextMultijumpTime));
				Global.ActivePlayer.NextMultijumpTime = Total Time Elapsed + 0.300;
				If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == True, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, And(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, And(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyModeActive == False, And(Global.ActivePlayer.TravelAttachmentActive == False, And(Global.ActivePlayer.JumpReviveConsumed == False, And(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect != 2, Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime <= Total Time Elapsed), Or(Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpConsumed == False, And(Global.ActivePlayer.JumpWasGrounded == False, Is On Ground(Global.ActivePlayer) == False))))))))));
					Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpConsumed = True;
					If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.JumpWasGrounded == False, Is On Ground(Global.ActivePlayer) == False));
						Apply Impulse(Global.ActivePlayer, 6 * Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpLevel - Y Component Of(Velocity Of(Global.ActivePlayer)) >= 0 ? Vector(0, 1, 0) : Vector(0, -1, 0), Absolute Value(6 * Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpLevel - Y Component Of(Velocity Of(Global.ActivePlayer))), To World, Incorporate Contrary Motion);
					End;
					Play Effect(All Players(All Teams), Ring Explosion, Global.RGB, Position Of(Global.ActivePlayer) + Vector(0, 0.050, 0), 1.500);
				Else;
					Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpConsumed = True;
				End;
			End;
		Else;
			Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpConsumed = False;
			Global.ActivePlayer.NextMultijumpTime = 0;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.JumpWasGrounded = Is On Ground(Global.ActivePlayer);
	}
}

rule("99q - Subroutine: Apply the Super Punch toggle")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplySuperPunchPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Release an already held attack button before another punch."
		Abort If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Or(Event Player.HudSlot < 0, Event Player.HudSlot >= 12));
		If(Array Contains(Global.SuperPunchPlayers, Event Player));
			Modify Global Variable(SuperPunchPlayers, Remove From Array By Value, Event Player);
			Global.SuperPunchTimes[Event Player.HudSlot] = 0;
		Else;
			Modify Global Variable(SuperPunchPlayers, Append To Array, Event Player);
			Global.SuperPunchTimes[Event Player.HudSlot] = -1;
		End;
	}
}

rule("89i - Subroutine: Apply Super Punch once per swing")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessSuperPunch;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Check throughout the actual swing without delay; an empty swing does not consume the punch."
		"Allow one target per swing; protection still consumes this contact."
		Abort If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot < 0, Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot >= Count Of(Global.SuperPunchTimes)));
		If(Is Meleeing(Global.ActivePlayer) == False);
			Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot] = 0;
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman == False, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot == True, Or(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer) == True, Or(Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer) == False, Or(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer) == False, Or(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer) == False, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerCycleActive == True, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed == True, Global.ActivePlayer.MeleeConsumed == True)))))))));
			Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot] = -1;
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot] == 0);
			Global.SuperPunchTarget = First Of(Sorted Array(Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Current Array Element != Global.ActivePlayer, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Has Spawned(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), And(Distance Between(Position Of(Global.ActivePlayer), Position Of(Current Array Element)) <= 2.500, And(Is In View Angle(Global.ActivePlayer, Eye Position(Current Array Element), 90), Is In Line Of Sight(Eye Position(Global.ActivePlayer), Eye Position(Current Array Element), Barriers Do Not Block LOS)))))))), Distance Between(Position Of(Global.ActivePlayer), Position Of(Current Array Element))));
			If(Global.SuperPunchTarget != Null);
				Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot] = -1;
			End;
			If(And(Global.SuperPunchTarget != Null, And(Entity Exists(Global.SuperPunchTarget), And(Has Spawned(Global.SuperPunchTarget), And(Is Alive(Global.SuperPunchTarget), And(Has Status(Global.SuperPunchTarget, Phased Out) == False, And(Has Status(Global.SuperPunchTarget, Unkillable) == False, Or(Player Variable(Global.SuperPunchTarget, UnkillableActive) == False, Player Variable(Global.SuperPunchTarget, UnkillableMode) == 0))))))));
				Kill(Global.SuperPunchTarget, Global.ActivePlayer);
			End;
			Global.SuperPunchTarget = Null;
		End;
	}
}

rule("89i1 - Super Punch: Handle native melee impact")
{
	event
	{
		Player Dealt Damage;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Array Contains(Global.SuperPunchPlayers, Event Player) == True;
		Event Ability == Button(Melee);
		Hero Of(Event Player) != Hero(Junker Queen);
		Event Damage > 0;
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Entity Exists(Event Player) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.PlayerCycleActive == False;
		Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed == False;
		Event Player.MeleeConsumed == False;
		Victim != Null;
		Victim != Event Player;
		Entity Exists(Victim) == True;
		Has Spawned(Victim) == True;
		Is Alive(Victim) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Native impact does not depend on animation sampling or the scheduler's temporary player."
		Abort If(Or(Event Player.HudSlot < 0, Event Player.HudSlot >= Count Of(Global.SuperPunchTimes)));
		Abort If(Global.SuperPunchTimes[Event Player.HudSlot] < 0);
		Global.SuperPunchTimes[Event Player.HudSlot] = -1;
		If(And(Has Status(Victim, Phased Out) == False, And(Has Status(Victim, Unkillable) == False, Or(Player Variable(Victim, UnkillableActive) == False, Player Variable(Victim, UnkillableMode) == 0))));
			Kill(Victim, Event Player);
		End;
	}
}

rule("89e - Subroutine: Maintain floating objective icons once per second")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		UpdateSocialObjectiveIcons;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Use twelve fixed slots; always release the previous owner before reusing a slot."
		"Start the new destination from the current position before the path ends; keep checks at one second."
		"Change the native icon type only when the choice changes; its color continues to follow the owner."
		For Global Variable(ObjectiveIconIndex, 0, 12, 1);
			If(And(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] != Null, And(Entity Exists(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]), And(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]), And(Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], IsHuman) == True, And(Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], PlayerListUpdatePending) == False, And(Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], TeamChangeProcessed) == False, Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], IconIndex) > 0))))) == False));
				If(Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] != 0);
					Destroy Icon(Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]);
				End;
				If(Entity Exists(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]));
					Stop Chasing Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition);
					Set Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition, Vector(0, 0.500, 0));
				End;
				Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
				Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
				Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = Null;
				Global.ObjectiveIconTimes[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
			End;
			If(And(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == Null, Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100));
				Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = First Of(Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, HudSlot) == Global.ObjectiveIconIndex, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Current Array Element), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, PlayerListUpdatePending) == False, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, TeamChangeProcessed) == False, Player Variable(Current Array Element, IconIndex) > 0))))))));
				If(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] != Null);
					Set Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition, Direction From Angles(Random Real(0, 360), 0) * Random Real(0, 10) + Vector(0, Random Real(0.500, 8), 0));
					Global.ObjectiveIconTimes[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = Total Time Elapsed;
					Chase Player Variable Over Time(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition, Direction From Angles(Random Real(0, 360), 0) * Random Real(0, 10) + Vector(0, Random Real(0.500, 8), 0), 4.500, None);
				End;
			End;
			If(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] != Null);
				If(Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ObjectiveIconTimes[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] + 3);
					Global.ObjectiveIconTimes[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = Total Time Elapsed;
					Chase Player Variable Over Time(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition, Direction From Angles(Random Real(0, 360), 0) * Random Real(0, 10) + Vector(0, Random Real(0.500, 8), 0), 4.500, None);
				End;

						Destroy Icon(Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]);
					End;
					Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;

				End;

rule("93e - Subroutine: Remove the objective icon on departure or team change")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		CleanupObjectiveIcon;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Cleanup uses the global registry and remains safe after the player entity disappears."
		For Global Variable(ObjectiveIconIndex, 0, 12, 1);
			If(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == Event Player);
				If(Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] != 0);
					Destroy Icon(Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]);
				End;
				If(Entity Exists(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]));
					Stop Chasing Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition);
					Set Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition, Vector(0, 0.500, 0));
				End;
				Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
				Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
				Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = Null;
				Global.ObjectiveIconTimes[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
			End;
		End;
	}
}
